Apple Music has unveiled a new brand identity, with a redesigned wordmark, musical-note imagery, and an original composition by Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics. Apple calls it “made by sound,” and this time the branding slogan comes with a fairly convincing science demonstration.

The team played musical frequencies through a rig, used the vibrations to move liquid, and filmed what happened to the Apple Music graphics underneath. The ripples and refractions became part of the new look. Somewhere, a perfectly serviceable logo-design brief turned into a physics experiment. I’m glad it did.

Fred again.. helped write the music that shaped the visuals

Apple’s behind-the-scenes film follows the process from sound to moving image. Individual notes create physical vibrations, which send waves through the liquid and distort the brand elements seen through it. Change the sound and you change the movement on camera.

Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics supplied the original composition behind that movement. It also gives the identity its own short musical signature, so the sound and animation belong together from the start. That’s a fitting approach for a music service: let the musicians influence what the thing looks like, too.

Apple says the visuals were captured entirely in camera. The glassy edges and shifting colors have a physical source, which makes the film more interesting than another animation that simply tells you a logo is exciting now. You can see the process in Apple’s video below.

The new wordmark has personality. But we’ll still miss the red branding on Apple Music

The Apple symbol now sits beside heavier, tightly packed lowercase “music” lettering. The musical note also gets a more expressive treatment, with the announcement showing it surrounded by liquid-like edges and flashes of color.

The wider shift toward black-and-white branding is more divisive for me. The old red gave Apple Music an immediately recognizable spot among your apps. A monochrome icon has to work harder to stand out beside all the other monochrome icons. Apparently, every app wants to wear the same outfit now.

The moving identity is where this redesign makes the strongest case for itself. Light bends around the note, colors appear at its edges, and the wordmark ripples with the composition. Those effects fit neatly into Apple’s broader Liquid Glass design language, while giving the music service an effect built around its own subject.

Apple has already paired a media rebrand with a musician through Apple TV’s new identity and Finneas sound. Fred again.. and NEST Acoustics give Apple Music its own version of that audiovisual introduction. A streaming service’s identity now apparently needs credits. At least these credits explain something worth watching.

The branding is official; the app rollout is still catching up

Parts of the refresh appeared during the iOS 27.2 beta cycle, including a black-and-white Music app icon. Those early app changes and the newly announced identity are parts of the same refresh, although the promotional animation and the small Home Screen icon serve very different jobs.

Apple’s launch post doesn’t give a complete platform-by-platform rollout schedule. If your devices still show the older branding, that alone doesn’t mean anything is broken. I’d wait for the normal software updates rather than install a beta to acquire a different-colored musical note.

This announcement is about the service’s look and sound as a brand. It doesn’t announce a new listening feature or subscription benefit. I like the craft behind it; the songs still have to do the rest.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

title.rendered: Honey Sprite in Fortnite: What it does and how to get it

content.rendered:
Honey Sprite has finally landed in Fortnite, completing the lineup of community-made sprites scheduled to release this season. It is the fifth such sprite to roll out in Fortnite Override, following X-Ray Sprite, Onigiri Sprite, Pond Sprite, and Dumpster Dive Sprite. It is also the twenty-seventh unique sprite currently available in the game overall.

Created by Conejito_sam, Honey Sprite was one of the winning submissions in Fortnite’s Design A Sprite Concept Royale, which took place in June and July. It was pushed into the game in the October 15 update (v42.40), alongside the Obsession-inspired One Wish Willow Sprite and the Quack sprite variant.

You can learn about Honey Sprite’s abilities and the various ways to add it to your collection in the following guide.

What Honey Sprite does in Fortnite

When equipped, Honey Sprite grants you a rather peculiar ability. Staying true to its name, it offers a chance of a swarm of bees being unleashed on your enemy when you deal damage to them using a gun or any other ranged weapon.

This ability also comes into play if you fire at anything other than an enemy, with the bees emerging at the hit point.

As you upgrade this Epic-tier sprite through its levels, the likelihood of a bee swarm appearing near your target increases steadily, from 5% at level 1 to 10% at level 5. There are also five other Honey Sprite variants you can master in Fortnite, as laid out below.

Honey Sprite variants and their uses

Besides the base variant, the following variants of Honey Sprite exist in Fortnite. On top of the bee ability, each variant grants an additional benefit based on its type.

  • Gold Honey Sprite: Gives three times more XP for eliminating an enemy.
  • Cheat Master Honey Sprite: Lets you enter cheat codes by tapping the buttons in any order.
  • Loot Hacker Honey Sprite: Increases the chances of items from your Loot Hacks appearing during a match.
  • Bounty Hunter Honey Sprite: Gives you a chance to obtain a Sprite by eliminating an opponent. However, this variant earns XP only from eliminations.
  • Trick or Treat Honey Sprite: Increases the chances of getting Halloween candy consumables from chests and other containers.

How to find Honey Sprite in Fortnite

1. Cheat codes

The best way to get your hands on Honey Sprite is by using cheat codes. Since it is a sprite of Epic rarity, you should aim to interact with pink and golden cheat codes, both of which usually offer Epic and higher-tier sprites.

In Fortnite Battle Royale, the most cheat code-dense areas are Heatwave Harbor, Cluster Coast and Sunken Shores, followed by Shaken Sanctuary. You can either visit these areas and scour them for the input consoles or use a Cheat Code Locator gizmo to mark a nearby cheat code. Those looking for this item can use one of the corresponding Fortnite Lobby Hacks to get it for free.

2. Pumpkin Chests

These are a special type of chest introduced in Fortnitemares 2026. Each one offers a sprite from the current roster, generally leaning towards the spooky-themed ones.

You can find multiple Pumpkin Chests in POIs such as Nightmare Neighborhood, Freaky Fields, Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria, Green Hill Zone, Shaken Sanctuary and Wonkeeland. It’s advisable to go through these locations while keeping an eye out for enemy players.

3. Rare Chests

If you have the Loot Hacker sprite equipped and the All Sprite Variants Loot Hack maxed out, you have a strong chance of getting sprites, including Honey Sprite, simply by opening chests, especially Rare Chests.

The places with the most of these blue-colored chests include Nightmare Neighborhood, Stone Sanctum, the Pac-Man islands, Cluster Coast, and the maze that lies northeast of Sunken Shores. These are some of the most highly contested hotspots on the Fortnite map, so it’s recommended to load up on ammunition before going there.

4. Get eliminations with the Bounty Hunter variant

Bounty Hunter sprites in Fortnite are very useful for growing your sprite collection, since they have a strong chance of providing a sprite when you eliminate an opponent. In other words, players who don’t want to be distracted by hunting for chests or cheat codes can rack up sprites as they go about their matches naturally.

5. Borrow and index it with the help of a friend

If you have a friend in Fortnite who already owns Honey Sprite, or can find someone willing to lend theirs temporarily, this is the easiest and most efficient way. The two of you just have to play a couple of matches together.

In the first match, ask your friend to let you take the sprite and extract with it to index it in your collection. In the second match, do the same thing in reverse and return the sprite to its original owner. Later, go to the Override tab, open the Sprites tab, and recall Honey Sprite from the list using Sprite Dust.

If you can’t find help this way, you can check out the official Fortnite Discord server for like-minded players.

Rounding up

Honey Sprite is among the more intriguing sprites in Fortnite, since it gives players an entirely new threat to deploy on enemies. It is also the final missing piece of the community-made sprites puzzle that was first teased at the beginning of the season.

It will be interesting to see how players warm up to this sprite and how popular it becomes among the current crop of these critters.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

title.rendered: Claude Duet wants to run your to-do list. First, join the waitlist

content.rendered:
Anthropic has introduced Claude Duet, an AI assistant that messages you first, checks what needs doing, and keeps working after you close your laptop. It can prepare a morning briefing, chase down unpaid invoices, or build a dashboard while you’re somewhere else.

The research preview opened on October 21. Duet runs on Claude Opus 5.5, with a separate app for iPhone and Android and web access at claude.ai. Anthropic is pitching it to professionals and small business owners. People whose to-do lists have started developing their own to-do lists, basically.

Only Pro and Max subscribers, and only in the US

You need a US Claude account, a Pro or Max subscription, and an invitation from the waitlist. Paying gets you eligibility. Then you wait for the email. Free, Team, and Enterprise users aren’t included in this preview.

Invitations are going out in waves, with no guaranteed date. If you’re in India, even a Max subscription won’t get you into the current preview. I’d hold off on upgrading just for Duet until Anthropic expands access.

There’s no extra Duet charge during the preview, but it shares your existing Claude usage limits. Its morning briefs and background checks count too. So yes, the assistant can use up some of your allowance before you’ve even opened a chat. Bigger jobs, such as financial models or slide decks, use more of it.

It can deal with the inbox or even with coding works

Duet sends a morning brief based on your connected accounts, then checks them every few hours for things that need your attention. You can tell it what deserves an interruption and how often you want updates. An assistant that announces every email has merely invented another inbox.

You can hand it work by typing or speaking. It has its own cloud computer and browser, so your devices don’t need to stay on. When a task is finished or needs your decision, it sends a notification. Your existing Claude memory, skills, and connected apps come with you, saving another round of explaining your job to a chatbot.

Anthropic says Duet can use more than 6,000 Marketplace connectors and plugins. Its examples include finding missed Gmail and Slack messages, drafting invoice reminders from QuickBooks, and preparing payroll in Gusto. It can also put together forecasts, presentations, dashboards, and web apps.

That’s a lot of responsibility for something you message from your phone. I’d start with the invoice reminder and see whether it understood the invoice.

It still needs your permission to send, spend, sign, or delete

Duet can read information and prepare work on its own. Before sending a message, making a payment, signing a document, or deleting anything, it’s designed to show you the action and wait for approval. Securities trading and moving money between accounts remain off-limits even if you say yes.

Purchases can go through Stripe’s Link wallet or Shopify’s Shop Pay. With Link, you approve the spend and it pays using a virtual card, keeping your real card number out of the transaction. Support for signing into sites through 1Password is coming later.

Anthropic also says Duet never directly sees passwords or sign-in tokens. A new safety check is designed to block sharing information such as card numbers and government IDs; sharing health or personal-finance details requires explicit instructions. That approval screen still deserves a read. An AI-written email can be wrong in impressively fluent English.

Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse. Everybody wants the job

Grok Bot already offers teams of agents that work across apps on a shared cloud computer. Its current beta covers eligible Grok and Cursor subscriptions, with a separate Bot usage allowance. That’s a different arrangement from Duet dipping into your regular Claude limits.

OpenAI Dots take on ongoing responsibilities inside ChatGPT, can reach you through Slack or Teams, and delegate work to ChatGPT Work or Codex. They’re rolling out to eligible Pro, Business Premium, and Enterprise accounts, with plan and regional restrictions. If your work already lives there, that continuity is a reason to look at Dots before adding another assistant.

Meta’s Muse leans further into personal errands, including shopping and booking travel, with access through its app or WhatsApp. Meta’s announced rollout starts in the US, with free access for much of its functionality and subscriptions for heavier use. Anthropic admits Duet’s personal errands, including ticket booking, are less developed. I’d take that admission seriously before handing it a holiday.

Duet’s appeal is strongest if Claude already knows your work. Switching assistants means reconnecting accounts and explaining yourself again. I need a better reason than a new app icon.

You can’t watch its browser yet. I’d like that fixed

Duet currently won’t let you watch or take over its browser. It can’t access local computer files, Microsoft 365 isn’t available yet, and some connectors have restrictions. The enormous connector count deserves that footnote.

Anthropic acknowledges that Duet can misread conversations or get urgency wrong. Something important can also arrive between its periodic checks. I’ll happily take help drafting a reminder, but I’d keep checking time-sensitive messages myself until the preview has earned more trust.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

title.rendered: One Piece pirate chest in Fortnite: Here’s where you can find it

content.rendered:
The forthcoming collaboration between Fortnite and One Piece has been something of an open secret for weeks now. In what appears to be the first implicit confirmation, a pirate chest has spawned on the Battle Royale island, possibly teasing players about the coming together of these two hugely popular IPs.

Thanks to the sudden appearance of this unmissable chest, which sits in a lagoon east of Sunken Shores, many Fortnite players have been flocking to it in anticipation of the Fortnite x One Piece collab, which is expected to be fully revealed soon. You can learn more about the pirate chest, its exact location in Fortnite, and the highly anticipated crossover below.

One Piece chest location in Fortnite

The pirate chest is well marked with a treasure chest icon on Fortnite’s Battle Royale map. Its location is flanked by Sunken Shores on the west and Pinky Island on the east. Moreover, it lies directly south of Mega Maze, the shapeshifting maze that is another POI known for being highly contested.

Upon reaching the exact spot, you will come across a giant chest emblazoned with a Jolly Roger. Parts of it may appear translucent blue, depending on how much of it has loaded in the game at that point in time. The other parts are opaque and painted in conventional colors. At the time of writing, more than half of the chest had yet to load.

The chest loads in one stage per day at 9 AM ET (6 AM PT) and should be fully visible by the end of this week.

According to information shared by X users Luwani and Wenso and corroborated by popular leaker SpushFNBR, you can hear certain songs playing near the chest. These songs are reportedly:

  • Birdbrain by Jamie Paige (ft. Kasane Teto)
  • Miku by Anamanaguchi (ft. Hatsune Miku)
  • RIOT by A$AP Rocky
  • What You Saying by Lil Uzi Vert

There are also voiceovers discovered in the game’s files that are audible in the vicinity of the chest.

Fortnite x One Piece collab: What to expect

According to leaks going back to late September, Fortnite x One Piece is planned as a mini-season for November. It would follow right after the Fortnite Override season, which is scheduled to run until October 31. Besides that, files for a similar crossover with the famed anime franchise were also spotted in Rocket League, another online multiplayer title owned by Epic Games.

ONE PIECE SHOULD BE THIS YEAR’S MINI SEASON 🔥👀 I’ve heard from many sources that One Piece will be happening at the end of this year, and will most likely be the November mini season! Recent Rocket League leaks seem to confirm this! #Fortnite | via: me & @SamLeakss https://t.co/YHZhRvYQ9J

— SpushFNBR (@SpushFNBR) September 23, 2026

Moving on from the mini-season reports, not much concrete information has surfaced about what the Fortnite x One Piece event may entail. However, judging by how previous Fortnite mini-seasons played out, we may see a themed Battle Pass, new map POIs, and loot pool updates roll out in the game.

Epic has also started teasing the mini-season itself. Posters spotted in Madrid and Tokyo this week show anime-style Fortnite characters and a pirate skull, though no One Piece characters. A$AP Rocky also teased a Fortnite collab with pirate imagery on October 21.

Wrapping up

The giant pirate chest is one of the most intriguing additions to Fortnite’s Chapter 7 Season 4 map as the Override season approaches its end. Its changing appearance, reported music, and voice lines have given players plenty to speculate about.

If the rumored One Piece crossover becomes official, it could become one of the best Fortnite collabs, bringing exciting new cosmetics, map changes, and themed gameplay to the island. However, Epic Games has yet to confirm the collaboration or reveal what it might include.

For now, players can visit the lagoon east of Sunken Shores and south of Mega Maze to check out the chest for themselves. We’ll know more when Epic Games shares an official announcement.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • All Pumpkin Chest locations in Fortnite
  • How to find and use the Skeleton Key in Fortnite

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

title.rendered: How to get Quack Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4

content.rendered:
In the final weeks of Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, the Quack Sprite variant has been brought back to the game after last appearing in the previous season, Runners. The v42.40 update on October 15 added five Quack Sprites alongside the new Honey and One Wish Willow Sprites, taking the total Sprite count in Fortnite Override to 162 different versions.

What separates the Quack Sprites from others is the exclusive way in which they need to be acquired. Unlike the various other Sprites, including original ones and those stemming from brand collabs, these Sprites can’t be obtained by any of the traditional methods, such as using cheat codes, opening chests, or even smashing the Pumpkin Chests that arrived with Fortnitemares.

Instead, each Quack Sprite requires you to master a certain number of Sprites in order to unlock it. Moreover, you only have until November 1 (Eastern Time) to tackle this challenge, as the Fortnite Override season ends on that day. Below, you can learn more about this Sprite variant itself and the different Sprite Mastery levels at which different Quack Sprites become claimable.

What Quack Sprites do in Fortnite?

Quack Sprites have a peculiar benefit in the sense that they don’t outright provide a gameplay boost or grant a unique ability. On the contrary, they do their work behind the scenes. According to Epic’s v42.40 update notes, whenever a Quack Sprite gains XP, every other Sprite you’re carrying gets extra Sprite XP as well. Community guides put that bonus at 50% of the XP the Quack Sprite earns.

That allows you to level up several Sprites at the same time in a single match, which makes a Quack Sprite most useful once you already have one and are pushing for the next mastery milestone.

All Quack Sprites in Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4

There are five different Quack Sprites available in Fortnite Override, namely:

  • Quack Jonesy Sprite
  • Quack Adventure Sprite
  • Quack Bush Sprite
  • Quack Klombo Sprite
  • Quack Spooky Dash Sprite

How to get Quack Sprite in Fortnite

As mentioned earlier, a particular Quack Sprite can only be unlocked by reaching a particular level of Sprite Mastery. Mastery corresponds to the number of Sprites that you level up to Level 5 through eliminations, opening chests, opening ammo boxes, and so on, and then successfully extract during a match.

You can either master a Sprite in one match itself, which would usually require you to go all the way and achieve a Victory Royale. Optionally, you can also level up a Sprite to an extent and extract it. Since these leveled-up Sprites retain their progress, you can continue where you left off in the next match, max the Sprite out, and extract the same eventually. Keep in mind that each Sprite counts only once toward your mastery total.

Here, you can check the number of Sprites that you would need to master in order to get any given Quack Sprite in Fortnite.

If you go further and master 70 Sprites, the same final Mastery page also rewards a new style for the Pixel Polli outfit.

Lastly, once you have reached the desired level, don’t forget to go to the Override tab and then the Mastery tab, from where you can easily claim the unlocked Quack Sprite.

How to reach the higher mastery levels faster

Since the Quack Jonesy Sprite unlocks first, it makes sense to equip it as soon as you claim it. Every match after that levels your other carried Sprites alongside it, which helps close the 20-Sprite gap between Quack Jonesy and Quack Klombo. Landing at loot-heavy spots, opening every chest and ammo box early, and extracting a Sprite as soon as it hits Level 5 also keep your progress safe.

How Season 4 Quack Sprites differ from Season 3

The Quack variant first arrived in Chapter 7 Season 3 with update v41.30 on July 30, 2026. Back then, it covered four different Sprites: Quack Water (35 mastered Sprites), Quack Earth (40), Quack Fire (45) and Quack Zero Point (55).

This season’s five Quack Sprites are built on different base Sprites and need up to 60 mastered Sprites, so they’re tracked separately from the Season 3 set.

How the Sprite pool has changed

Throughout Fortnite Override, Sprites have received a lot of interesting updates, ranging from brand-collab Sprites to community-made ones. The latest update from October 15 brought the One Wish Willow Sprite, the Honey Sprite and the Quack Sprites into the mix, which further populated and diversified the existing pool.

Given that this time it’s just two new Sprites and the return of an older variant from Fortnite Runners, some players may have found it not as exciting as they would have hoped.

However, the coupled rollout of the One Wish Willow Sprite and the Quack Sprites makes it a suitable time for those players pushing to complete and master their Sprite collection before a new Fortnite season kicks off. One Wish Willow lets you pull out an enemy’s equipped Sprites as soon as you eliminate them, while also knocking nearby enemies back when you take damage. The only catch is that removing it marks you on the map.

  • Blinky Sprite in Fortnite: The easiest method to claim it

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

title.rendered: Download spooky Halloween wallpapers for iPhone in 4K

content.rendered:
It’s time to add a touch of horror to your iPhone screen! Give your device a spooky makeover this Halloween with a collection of wallpapers we’ve curated especially for you. From ghostly figures and glowing pumpkins to eerie landscapes and creepy characters, there’s something for every Halloween lover.

Whether you prefer cute Halloween designs or dark, chilling scenes, these wallpapers will bring the perfect spooky vibe to your Lock Screen and Home Screen. Explore our collection below and download the best Halloween wallpapers for iPhone in stunning 4K quality to celebrate the season in style.

1. Ghost over the starlit village 

A cheerful little ghost floats above a charming village, holding a glowing pumpkin lantern. I like how the sky with a crescent moon, glowing stars, and a fairytale castle on the mountain creates a Halloween dreamscape. 

Download

2. Gothic midnight 

If you want a classic haunted castle on your screen, go for this one. A towering gothic mansion beneath a golden full moon with flying bats and swirling fog makes the atmosphere eerie. 

Download

3. Halloween witch kitten 

Who said Halloween wallpaper can’t be cute? Check out this one. A fluffy black kitten wearing a witch hat sits atop ancient spellbooks surrounded by warm candles, pumpkins, and autumn leaves.  

Download

4. Haunted Halloween pattern 

A beautiful Halloween pattern features smiling pumpkins, adorable white ghosts, black bats, tiny spiders, candy corn, and orange maple leaves. The dark background makes the bright decorations stand out beautifully. 

Download

5. Halloween pumpkin field 

A mist-covered pumpkin field stretches beneath an orange sunset. Glowing jack-o’-lanterns, a distant scarecrow, and skeletal trees make it a scene from a supernatural film.

Download

6. Minimalist Halloween twilight 

Next is a minimalist wallpaper with a crescent moon and scattered bats against a dramatic sky. I loved how the twisted tree and distant mountains complete this simple yet striking Halloween scene. 

Download

7. Rain-soaked Jack-o’-Lantern 

If your Halloween means pumpkin decoration, this wallpaper is ideal. A carved pumpkin glows intensely on a rain-soaked porch with reflections across the pavement. It creates a dramatic autumn-night setting. 

Download

8. Rainy autumn candlelight 

Here is a rainy Halloween evening with a perfect romantic setting. Flickering candles, miniature pumpkins, old books, and a steaming mug create a comforting autumn sanctuary. 

Download

9. Smoldering Jack-o’-Lantern  

Looking for spooky dark wallpaper? A menacing carved pumpkin emerges from near-total darkness, creating a haunting, high-contrast design for horror lovers. 

Download

10. Violet crystal Jack-o’-Lantern   

Another Jack- o’-Lantern wallpaper, but this time it’s a glossy, crystal-like pumpkin shining with vivid violet reflections. Its dramatic dark backdrop gives a futuristic fantasy Halloween aesthetic. 

Download

11. Blood Moon Haunted Valley 

The massive red moon is a main character in a Halloween wallpaper, surrounded by the twisted branches of a sinister dead tree. The flying bats, distant mountains, and misty valleys deepen the supernatural sense of dread on my screen.

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

title.rendered: What is Optimized Battery Charging on iPhone and how do I use it?

content.rendered:
No matter how advanced your iPhone’s processor or camera may be, all those cutting-edge features are only as good as your battery. You’re not alone if you’ve ever reached for a charger sooner than you’d like. Every lithium-ion battery gradually loses capacity, which means less time between charges as the months go by. The good news? Apple has your back with Optimized Battery Charging. This clever iOS feature is built to help slow down battery aging so you can enjoy your iPhone for longer without worrying about constant battery replacements.

In this guide, I’ll explain everything you need to know about Optimized Battery Charging: what it is, how it works, the pros and cons, and how you can set it up to fit your daily routine. Whether you’re a longtime iPhone user or just curious about getting the most out of your device, you’ll find practical tips to help your battery stay healthier and last longer.

What is Optimized Battery Charging?

Think of Optimized Battery Charging as your iPhone’s way of looking out for you and itself. This innovative feature is designed to help your battery last longer by cutting down on your phone’s time sitting at a full 100% charge. Once you turn it on, your iPhone learns your charging habits and determines the best time to finish charging so your battery isn’t under unnecessary stress. After all, letting a lithium-ion battery linger at 100% for too long can speed up its aging process, but with this feature, your device does the heavy lifting to help keep your battery healthy for the long haul.

Note: While this feature is currently designed for iPhones, similar battery optimization features are available on some Android devices and laptops. And if you use an Apple Watch, you can learn how to manage its optimized charging settings in our dedicated Apple Watch guide.

Optimized Battery Charging vs. standard charging

Figuring out the difference between traditional charging and Optimized Battery Charging can help you make the smartest choice for your daily routine and your iPhone’s long-term health.

If you’re the type who always needs your phone to hit 100% as fast as possible, no matter what time it is, standard charging is probably your best bet. It’s quick and predictable, but keep in mind that always rushing to full charge can wear out your battery faster over time. On the other hand, Optimized Battery Charging takes a more thoughtful approach. It might hold off on that last bit of charging sometimes, but it’s doing so to help your battery last longer, so you can keep your phone running strong day after day.

How does Optimized Battery Charging work?

Here’s how the feature operates:

  1. Learns Your Routine: Your iPhone uses on-device machine learning to understand when you typically charge and unplug your device.
  2. Charges Normally Up to 80%: The battery charges at regular speed until it reaches 80%.
  3. Pauses Charging: Once at 80%, charging is paused to avoid prolonged time at full charge.
  4. Completes Charge Before You Need It: Based on your routine, your iPhone finishes charging to 100% just before you usually unplug it.

Example: If you typically plug in your iPhone at 10 PM and unplug it at 7 AM, the device will charge to 80% quickly, then wait. Around 6:30 AM, it will resume charging so you have a full battery when you wake up.

Charge Limit options on iPhone 15 and later

Charge Limit is available on iPhone 15 and later. That covers the iPhone 15, 16, and 17 series, iPhone Air, iPhone 16e and 17e, and the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Pick any limit from 80% to 100%, in 5% steps, and your iPhone will generally stop charging at that number. For instance, if you choose 85%, your phone will stay around that level instead of topping up to 100%.

Apple added this option to give you more control over your battery’s health and long-term performance. It’s a good way to slow battery aging even further. Remember, though, that a lower limit means your iPhone might not last quite as long between charges as it would at 100%. Even with a limit set, your iPhone will occasionally charge to 100% to keep its battery readings accurate. It’s all about finding the best balance for your daily routine!

Impact on device performance and battery health

1. Slowing battery aging and preserving capacity

When you let Optimized Battery Charging do its thing, your iPhone spends less time sitting at 100%, and that’s a big win for your iPhone battery’s health. This simple tweak helps slow down the chemical aging process, so you’re less likely to need a battery replacement anytime soon and can enjoy smoother performance from your device for longer.

The numbers can vary, but studies and real-world user experiences show that constantly keeping your battery at 100% can speed up capacity loss, sometimes by as much as 20% over two years! Optimized Battery Charging gives your phone a better shot at holding onto its original capacity so that you can get more life out of every charge.

2. Maintaining peak performance

A healthy battery helps your iPhone maintain peak performance. When battery health declines, iOS may activate performance management features (sometimes called “throttling”) to prevent unexpected shutdowns. Optimized Battery Charging can help your device avoid slowdowns and deliver a more consistent user experience by maintaining battery health.

Users who consistently use this feature often report higher battery health percentages (as seen in Settings > Battery > Battery Health) even after a year or more, compared to those who disable the feature.

3. Compatibility with fast charging

Optimized Battery Charging works seamlessly with fast charging technologies. Your iPhone will still fast-charge up to 80%, then pause as needed to protect battery health. This means you get the convenience of rapid charging without sacrificing long-term performance.

4. Benefits across device generations

The effectiveness of Optimized Battery Charging may be even greater on newer iPhones (iPhone 15 and later) thanks to more advanced battery chemistry and the added option to set custom charging limits. However, even older iPhones benefit from reduced wear and more stable performance over time.

5. Impact on resale and trade-in value

Maintaining higher battery health can directly impact your iPhone’s resale or trade-in value. Devices with a battery health above 85% are more desirable and may fetch higher prices on the secondhand market.

Benefits of Optimized Battery Charging

  1. Reduces Battery Wear: By minimizing the time your iPhone spends at 100%, you slow down the chemical aging process of the battery.
  2. Preserves Battery Capacity: Helps maintain your iPhone’s battery health and performance for a longer period.
  3. Delays Battery Replacement: With less wear, you’re less likely to need a battery replacement as soon.
  4. Convenient and Automatic: Once enabled, the feature works in the background without requiring any extra effort from you.

Why does this matter?

Lithium-ion batteries degrade faster when kept at full charge, especially in warm conditions. Reducing time at 100% helps preserve your battery’s ability to hold a charge.

How to enable, customize, or disable Optimized Battery Charging on iPhone

For iPhone 15 and later:

  1. Open Settings > Battery.
  2. Tap Charging.
  3. Choose a charge limit between 80% and 100%, in 5% steps.
  4. Set the limit to 100%. You can then also turn on Optimized Battery Charging.

For iPhone 14 and earlier:

This covers iPhone 11 through iPhone 14, including both iPhone SE models. Charge Limit starts at iPhone 15, so these models only get the on/off switch.

  1. Open Settings > Battery.
  2. Tap Battery Health & Charging.
  3. Toggle Optimized Battery Charging on or off.

Temporary override:

If you need a full charge sooner than usual, touch and hold the charging notification on your Lock Screen and tap “Charge Now.” That finishes charging sooner instead of waiting for your usual unplug time.

Default setting:

Optimized Battery Charging is on by default when you set up your iPhone.

When should you disable Optimized Battery Charging?

In most cases, leaving Optimized Battery Charging enabled is best. However, you might want to disable it if:

  1. You have irregular charging schedules (charging at different times each day).
  2. You need your phone fully charged earlier than usual (for example, before early travel).
  3. You have an emergency and need a quick full charge.

Tip: If you’re leaving for the airport at 4 AM instead of your usual 7 AM, consider turning off Optimized Battery Charging the night before to ensure a full charge.

General tips for battery health

  1. Avoid Extreme Temperatures: Charging in very hot or cold environments can accelerate battery aging.
  2. Use Approved Chargers: Stick to Apple-certified or high-quality chargers for safe, efficient charging.
  3. Don’t Let Your Battery Drain Completely: Try to recharge before your battery drops to 0% for optimal longevity.

Example: Avoid charging your iPhone in direct sunlight or leaving it plugged in inside a hot car.

Let your iPhone charge the smart way

Optimized Battery Charging is a powerful tool for extending your iPhone’s battery lifespan and maintaining long-term performance. By learning your routine and managing the charging process, it helps you get the most out of your device with minimal effort. For most users, leaving the feature enabled is the best way to keep your iPhone running smoothly for years to come. If your needs change, Apple makes it easy to customize or disable the feature as needed.

FAQs

Does Optimized Battery Charging slow down charging?

No. Your iPhone charges at normal speed up to 80%. The last 20% is intentionally delayed to protect battery health, but you can override this if needed.

Does it work with fast charging?

Yes. Fast charging is supported up to 80%. The optimization only affects the timing of the final portion of the charge.

Is it safe to leave on all the time?

Absolutely. For most users, keeping the feature enabled is the best way to preserve battery health. If your needs change, you can always disable it.

What if my routine is unpredictable?

The feature works best with consistent charging habits. If your schedule varies, you may not see the full benefits, but it won’t harm your device.

Read more:

  • How to turn off Optimized Battery Charging on Apple Watch
  • How to check iPhone charge cycle count
  • How to fix iPhone battery draining faster

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Does Optimized Battery Charging slow down charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your iPhone charges at normal speed up to 80%. The last 20% is intentionally delayed to protect battery health, but you can override this if needed.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with fast charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fast charging is supported up to 80%. The optimization only affects the timing of the final portion of the charge.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to leave on all the time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. For most users, keeping the feature enabled is the best way to preserve battery health. If your needs change, you can always disable it.

mainEntity.name: What if my routine is unpredictable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The feature works best with consistent charging habits. If your schedule varies, you may not see the full benefits, but it won't harm your device.

keyPoints.title: What is Optimized Battery Charging?
keyPoints.explanation: It's an iOS feature designed to slow battery aging by reducing the time your iPhone spends at a full 100% charge, learning your habits to finish charging just before you need to use your phone.

keyPoints.title: Optimized Battery Charging vs. Standard Charging
keyPoints.explanation: While standard charging quickly reaches 100% and maintains it, optimized charging pauses at around 80% and finishes just before you typically unplug, helping extend battery lifespan.

keyPoints.title: How Does Optimized Battery Charging Work?
keyPoints.explanation: It learns your routine, charges to 80%, pauses, then resumes charging to 100% just before you usually unplug, ensuring minimal stress on the battery.

keyPoints.title: New Charging Limit Options in iOS 18+
keyPoints.explanation: On iOS 18 and later, especially on iPhone 15/16, you can set specific maximum charge levels (like 80%, 85%, etc.) to further protect battery health.

keyPoints.title: Benefits and Impact on Battery Health
keyPoints.explanation: Optimized charging reduces battery wear, maintains performance, and can even increase resale value by preserving higher battery health over time.

"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: Apple Watch icons and symbols: What they mean

content.rendered:
If you have just bought a new Apple Watch, you will likely notice at least one icon, known or unknown, at the top center of its display. Some appear at the top of the screen, others sit inside the Control Center, and many appear during workouts, charging, or system alerts. While you might already be familiar with a few, some icons can be confusing, especially if you are a new Apple Watch user. Therefore, knowing what each symbol means helps you use your watch with confidence and avoid confusion when unexpected events occur.

To help you out, I’ve prepared this definitive guide on the meanings of all the Apple Watch icons and symbols.

Apple Watch status icons

Status icons appear at the top of the Apple Watch screen and give you a quick snapshot of what your watch is doing. They help you understand connectivity, active features, and alerts at a glance before you dive into the detailed meanings.

1. Red dot icon

The Red Dot icon at the top center of your Apple Watch signifies that you have at least one unread notification. To access the notification center, swipe down on your Watch Face or long-press the top edge of the screen, then swipe down if you are within an app.

2. Green Lightning icon

The green lightning or flash icon indicates that your Apple Watch is currently connected to a charger and successfully charging.

3. Red Lightning icon

The Red Lightning icon appears when your Apple Watch’s battery is low. To use it again, you must attach it to its charging cradle. The icon usually appears when your Apple Watch battery falls well below the Low Power mode mark, i.e., 10%.

4. Lock icon

If you notice a Lock icon, it means your Apple Watch is locked with the passcode you set up during initial setup. With wrist detection enabled, the Passcode Lock automatically activates when you remove the Apple Watch from your wrist. Without wrist detection, you’ll need to manually activate the lock from the Control Center.

Simply enter your passcode to unlock your Apple Watch.

5. Water drop icon – Water Lock

The Water Drop or Water Lock appears when you turn on the Water Lock feature in the Apple Watch’s Control Center. When activated, it prevents your Apple Watch from responding to display touches, helping prevent accidental exposure to water.

To deactivate this feature, simply press and hold the Digital Crown until the display says Unlocked. A series of tones then plays to eject the water from the Apple Watch’s speaker.

6. Crescent moon icon

The Crescent Moon appears when you activate Do Not Disturb mode in the Control Center on your Apple Watch or the paired iPhone, if the Share Across Devices setting is on. Once enabled, Do Not Disturb mode silences all calls and other alerts; however, alarms will still ring.

7. Airplane mode

If you see the Airplane icon on your Apple Watch, it means Airplane Mode is active, and all features that require a wireless connection are unavailable.

8. Dual Face Mask icon

The Dual Face Mask represents Theater Mode, which can be enabled or disabled in the Control Center. As the name suggests, the mode is intended for use in places that require zero distractions. The mode restricts your Apple Watch from lighting up whenever a new notification arrives and also disables the Always-on Display if your Apple Watch supports it.


9. Workout icon

This icon appears when your Apple Watch detects that you are in a workout session, or when you manually start a workout in the Workout app. Tapping the icon takes you to the workout-tracking screen in the Workout app, where you can pause and resume the workout.


10. Red cross icon

This status icon indicates that your GPS + Cellular Apple Watch has lost its cellular network connection.

11. iPhone disconnected icon

Represented by an iPhone with a slash over it, the iPhone Disconnected icon indicates that your Apple Watch has lost connection to the paired iPhone. To fix the issue, try bringing your Apple Watch and the paired iPhone close together, disabling Airplane Mode if it is active, or restarting your Apple Watch.


12. iPhone icon

Represented by a green iPhone symbol, this icon appears at the top center of the Control Center whenever the Apple Watch is connected to the paired iPhone.

13. Location indicator icon

This Apple Watch icon signifies an app or the Watch face that requires location services to display information, such as weather details, or is currently using your location.

14. Wi-Fi icon

As you can see, the Wi-Fi icon appears when you connect your Apple Watch to a Wi-Fi network.

15. Wireless activity icon

This icon appears when wireless activity is taking place or when an active process is running.

16. Mic icon

The orange Mic icon appears when an app or service uses the Apple Watch’s mic to listen to external audio. This icon usually pops up when using Siri, recording a voice memo, and more.


17. Now Playing icon

Represented by a striped play button, the Now Playing icon appears when music is playing on the Apple Watch or the paired iPhone. Tapping the icon takes you to the Now Playing screen, where you can control media playback.

18. LTE icon

The LTE icon represents the cellular signal strength on your GPS + Cellular Apple Watch model.

19. Call icon

The green phone icon appears when you are on an active call, on either the Apple Watch or the paired iPhone. Tapping the icon will take you to the calling screen, where you can transfer calls between your iPhone and Apple Watch.

20. Maps icon

Appears when the Apple Watch is being used to provide directions using the Apple Maps app.

21. Navigation icon

It appears when a third-party app is being used to provide directions on the Apple Watch.

22. Car icon

This car appears when you enable Car Focus on the paired iPhone, and the Share Focus Across Devices setting is enabled on it.

24. Yellow circle (Low Power mode) icon

The yellow circle represents the Low Power Mode icon on the Apple Watch, which can be enabled or disabled via the Control Center or the battery settings on the watch.

Apple Watch Control Center specific icons

Status icons appear at the top of the Apple Watch screen and give you a quick snapshot of what your watch is doing. They help you understand connectivity, active features, and alerts at a glance before you dive into the detailed meanings.

25. Cellular icon

Tapping this icon enables or disables cellular connectivity on your Apple Watch with eSIM functionality.

26. Wi-Fi icon

Tapping the Wi-Fi icon toggles Wi-Fi connectivity on your Apple Watch.

27. Ping iPhone

This Control Center icon helps you quickly locate your misplaced paired iPhone. When you tap this icon, the paired iPhone makes a loud beeping sound, which you can hear to locate the iPhone.

28. Battery percentage

This icon shows the current available battery level on your Apple Watch. Moreover, you can enable low power mode on your Apple Watch by tapping this icon and choosing the appropriate option.

29. Silent icon

As the name suggests, tapping this icon puts your Apple Watch in Silent Mode. Once enabled, the bell icon will transform into a crossed bell icon and vice versa.

30. Flashlight

This Control Center button transforms your Apple Watch display into a flashlight. There are three flashlight modes, and you can switch between them by simply swiping across the display.

31. AirPlay icon

The AirPlay icon in the Control Center lets you choose the audio output device for your Apple Watch.

32. Sleep mode icon

As you might expect, the icon indicates that your Apple Watch is in sleep mode. When in this mode, the display will turn off, and when you tap the screen, the sleep timer will appear. You can set the sleep mode time in the Settings app.

33. Work Focus mode icon

Appears when Work Focus is enabled on your Apple Watch or any of your Apple devices. This Focus is aimed at limiting distractions caused by the Apple Watch during your work hours, and the Work Focus icon appears at the top center and in the Control Center when enabled.

34. Personal Focus mode icon

Similar to Work Mode Focus, Personal Focus also appears when enabled on your Apple Watch or other Apple devices. The icon shows up on your Watch Face and in the Control Center.

35. Double A icon

This icon represents the Dynamic Type feature, which lets you choose the text size displayed on your Apple Watch.

36. Bell with wavy lines icon

This icon represents the Siri Announce feature, which reads all incoming notifications aloud when the Apple Watch is connected to supported headphones (AirPods or certain Beats models). However, you must allow Siri to announce notifications in the Apple Watch and paired iPhone settings.

37. Ear-Shaped icon

This icon on the Apple Watch indicates the Hearing Devices options that appear when the headphone volume exceeds a certain threshold, which could affect your hearing.

38. Compass icon

This icon appears when you use the Backtrack feature on the supported Apple Watch models. The feature helps you backtrack your steps and traveled routes in case you are lost.

Signing off…

And that’s it; these were all the icons and symbols you might have noticed on your Apple Watch at one point or another. While most icons are self-explanatory, some, like the Location Indicator or Red Dot, can confuse new Apple Watch users. We tried covering almost all the icons and symbols that may appear on your Apple Watch screen. If we missed anything, please let us know in the comments below.

  • Apple Intelligence on Apple Watch: All the new features in watchOS 27

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

mainEntity.name: Does Optimized Battery Charging slow down charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your iPhone charges at normal speed up to 80%. The last 20% is intentionally delayed to protect battery health, but you can override this if needed.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with fast charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fast charging is supported up to 80%. The optimization only affects the timing of the final portion of the charge.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to leave on all the time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. For most users, keeping the feature enabled is the best way to preserve battery health. If your needs change, you can always disable it.

mainEntity.name: What if my routine is unpredictable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The feature works best with consistent charging habits. If your schedule varies, you may not see the full benefits, but it won't harm your device.

Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

title.rendered: Apple sets October 28 event titled ‘Pro and tell’

content.rendered:
Apple has scheduled a special event for October 28, with the tagline “Pro and tell.” The event starts at 10 a.m. Pacific time in Los Angeles. The report doesn’t name a venue or say whether the event will be streamed.

It is Apple’s second event this month

The October 13 Welcome home event in New York introduced the $299 HomeView smart display, the HomePod mini 2, and a new Apple TV 4K. October 28 is the second event in the month.

The tagline is a play on “show and tell.” The report doesn’t describe the invitation artwork. Apple’s Greg Joswiak posted a teaser, “Can’t wait to pro and tell next week,”.

Can’t wait to pro and tell next week. https://t.co/3wUkxwq35i

— Greg Joswiak (@gregjoz) October 19, 2026

Bloomer’s Gurman points to a touchscreen MacBook Pro and a new iPad mini

Bloomer’s Mark Gurman has reported that the lineup could include a touchscreen MacBook Pro in 14- and 16-inch sizes. Gurman says it would use OLED displays, have a Dynamic Island for the first time, and be “significantly lighter,” with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

He also reports a revamped iPad mini with an OLED screen, a new speaker system, and a relocated FaceTime camera. Gurman reports that the OLED iPad mini will cost considerably more than today’s $599 model, possibly close to $799. A new iMac and an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M6 chip are also expected to “look like their current versions.”

Most of the rumored lineup is Mac and iPad hardware, and Apple hasn’t confirmed any of these products. For the rest of Apple’s 2026 pipeline, see the upcoming Apple products list.

The touchscreen MacBook Pro date is not settled

Gurman has also said on a podcast that the touchscreen MacBook Pro could launch on Friday, November 6. If that date is right, the product would go on sale about nine days after the October 28 event.

The date, time, location, and tagline are the only details 9to5Mac says Apple has confirmed. Treat the product list as rumor until Apple announces it. If you plan to buy an iPad mini soon, the current $599 model is the price to compare against.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s “Pro and tell” media event takes place in Los Angeles on October 28 at 10 a.m. Pacific Time. A touchscreen MacBook Pro and an OLED iPad mini remain unconfirmed.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

title.rendered: John Ternus is still hands-on with Apple’s design teams

content.rendered:
Apple CEO John Ternus has spent multiple days a week in the studio with the company’s industrial-design and human-interface teams, according to TIME’s reporting. Andrew R. Chow interviewed him for TIME in September, after Ternus took over from Tim Cook on September 1.

TIME published the interview on October 15, ahead of its Best Inventions of 2026 issue, which goes on sale October 26. The full video went up on YouTube on October 20, and 9to5Mac’s writeup of it focused on the design comments. The interview also covers the iPhone Duo, memory shortages, and AI.

Ternus pushed the Duo team to keep working while rivals shipped

Richard Dinh, Apple’s VP of product design, recounts a moment when he asked Ternus whether the team should use a surface material similar to competitors’. Ternus replied, “Look, Rich, you’ll know when it’s the right thing.” According to TIME, that answer gave the team the confidence to push further. Ternus also encouraged the team to invest more time and effort even as rivals reached the market first. Tim Cook, now executive chairman, has said separately that he is not meddling with Ternus.

Hardware and software teams built the Duo together

The iPhone Duo folds to about passport size and opens into a tablet-sized screen. TIME names Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold8 as its closest rival, and early testers say the crease is barely noticeable. TIME cites those testers without independent tests.

TIME reports that hardware and software teams worked together on the Duo’s display engine and on moving the main controls to the right side of the screen. The hinge has more than 100 small interior parts, and the Duo’s surface is matte and light-deflecting.

Design decisions on the Duo have drawn other reports. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported that Apple dropped a shorter Apple Pencil for the Duo before production.

Dinh credits Ternus with the collaboration: “John was really at the center of driving the spirit of collaboration across the company.”

An engineer who filed a foldable patent in 2011

Ternus studied mechanical engineering and joined Apple in 2001 as an engineer. In 2011, he and five other engineers filed a patent for foldable devices. That puts his interest in foldables more than a decade before the Duo.

In the full video, Ternus says he has worked hand in hand with industrial designers since he joined Apple, according to 9to5Mac’s writeup. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman had already reported in October 2025 that Ternus was the leading candidate to succeed Cook, nearly a year before the handoff.

On rival foldables, Ternus told TIME, “The other examples in the world felt kind of cheap and crappy.”

He also said Apple doesn’t have to make every part of a product itself. He said the company tries to “constrain ourselves to the stuff that matters most.”

The Duo’s success is far from guaranteed

TIME calls the Duo’s success “far from guaranteed” and says many buyers may balk at its price.

mainEntity.name: Why isn’t the Always On display working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: There could be several reasons. However, you can easily troubleshoot the Always On display when it’s not working on your Apple Watch to get it working again.

mainEntity.name: Why does the display dim when Always On is enabled?

acceptedAnswer.text: The display dims in Always On mode to conserve battery life. Keeping the screen at full brightness constantly would drain the battery much faster. Therefore, Apple has designed the Always On feature to tone down the brightness when your Apple Watch is idle.

mainEntity.name: Do all watch faces support Always On?

acceptedAnswer.text: As mentioned earlier, the Always On feature simplifies the visuals of the watch face and displays essential information when it is idle. Therefore, in Always On mode, the watch face may not appear as it normally does.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft without cheats?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you need to enable cheats in order to change gamemodes in Minecraft. Once that’s done, you can use commands or the gamemode switcher to do so.

mainEntity.name: What is the command to change gamemode in Minecraft?

acceptedAnswer.text: The command to change gamemode in Minecraft is /gamemode, followed by the mode you wish to play. For instance, enter /gamemode creative to play Creative mode.

mainEntity.name: Can you change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but you need operator (op) permissions, which can be granted by the server owner, to change gamemode in Minecraft multiplayer. The F3 + F4 shortcut on Java servers also depends on those permissions.

mainEntity.name: Does Optimized Battery Charging slow down charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your iPhone charges at normal speed up to 80%. The last 20% is intentionally delayed to protect battery health, but you can override this if needed.

mainEntity.name: Does it work with fast charging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fast charging is supported up to 80%. The optimization only affects the timing of the final portion of the charge.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to leave on all the time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. For most users, keeping the feature enabled is the best way to preserve battery health. If your needs change, you can always disable it.

mainEntity.name: What if my routine is unpredictable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The feature works best with consistent charging habits. If your schedule varies, you may not see the full benefits, but it won't harm your device.

title.rendered: Perplexity Computer can now run fully locally on Mac

content.rendered:
Perplexity says its Computer agent can now run fully locally on Mac. The model, the agent harness, and task execution all run on the device, so personal files and apps can be handled without sending that data to the cloud. The feature is called Local Computer on Mac, and it is available now to Pro, Max, and Enterprise subscribers.

Perplexity’s example is a portfolio analysis that combines private holdings with downloaded market data. It is the kind of task people may not want to send to a cloud service. Local Computer builds on Personal Computer for Mac, which launched in May and gave Computer access to local files and native Mac apps.

Planning, reasoning, and files stay on the Mac

In fully local mode, planning, reasoning, and file processing run on the device. The model is either Qwen 3.6 or PPLX Pro, which Perplexity describes as a post-trained version of Qwen. Code and tool execution run in isolated sandbox environments with controlled access to files and connected apps. Computer works across local files and supported apps, including Notes, Messages, Mail, and Numbers.

Web and connected-app tasks still use the cloud

Tasks that need current information, browser use, or cloud-connected apps need the user’s approval before they go to the cloud. The local orchestrator can also call one of more than 15 frontier models for harder reasoning. Perplexity doesn’t say how often that happens in local mode, so “fully local” describes the on-device default. It is not a promise that no cloud model is involved.

Perplexity also doesn’t say how many credits a local run uses. Users choose where each task runs and how to spend their credits.

Perplexity recommends 36GB of memory

Perplexity says the feature works on “supported Apple silicon Macs” but doesn’t name the models. It gives no minimum memory or macOS version. It does recommend 36GB or more for running Computer locally. Perplexity points to the new Mac mini as an example of a supported machine. The M6 Mac mini tops out at 32GB of unified memory, which falls short of that recommendation. Buyers who want local mode should check the memory configuration before they buy.

Big local models need a lot of memory

Local AI depends on memory. Meta says two M5 Ultra Mac Studios can host its 816-billion-parameter Muse Spark Open model. Moonshot’s Kimi K3 open weights take up roughly 1.56TB, which puts them out of reach for most MacBooks. Perplexity hasn’t said how large its local models are, so the 36GB figure is the best guide for now.

Who gets it and how to set it up

Local Computer on Mac is available to Pro, Max, and Enterprise subscribers. Perplexity doesn’t mention Free users or give a price for the feature. The setup has three steps:

  1. Download and open the latest Perplexity Mac app.
  2. Follow the in-app instructions to download a local model.
  3. Choose the fully local option for a task.

What Perplexity hasn’t said

Perplexity hasn’t given a minimum memory figure, a macOS version, a full list of supported Macs, or any speed or accuracy data. It also doesn’t say how Qwen 3.6 differs from PPLX Pro or how to choose between them. The privacy claims come from Perplexity, and there are no independent tests yet. Until someone runs it on a smaller Mac, plan around 36GB.

Looking for Turbo Soccer codes? Well, you’ve come to the right place! In this Roblox game, you’ll be driving cars around the pitch to score goals and outplay your opponents. However, you’ll need the best fields, cards, and cars if you want to wreck the competition. Luckily, Turbo Soccer codes can help you unlock free rewards! With that said, let’s take a look at all the codes you should redeem right now.

All working Turbo Soccer codes

  • BONUS10: 10% bonus Coins on your next Coin purchase (NEW)
