title.rendered: Drop a Fruit codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Drop a Fruit Codes on October 23, 2026

Looking for the latest Drop a Fruit codes? You’ve come to the right place! Developed by Together Studios, this Roblox simulation game lets you use codes to claim a bunch of freebies such as Luck Boosts and Coins, which can help you get better drops and progress faster. Without further ado, let’s check out all the active Drop a Fruit codes for October 2026 and how you can redeem them before they expire!

All working Drop a Fruit codes

  • update1: 3357 Coins and a 100% Luck Boost for 10 minutes (NEW)
  • halloween: Coins and Luck Boost (NEW)

As of now, this is the only active Drop a Fruit code available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired or unverified Drop a Fruit codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Drop a Fruit codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Drop a Fruit codes:

  1. Fire up Drop a Fruit on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the Settings button.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Drop a Fruit codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for Drop a Fruit codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest The Company codes, Anime Dice codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Why Are My Drop a Fruit Codes Not Working?

Make sure you’ve entered the code exactly as shown in our list, including the correct spelling, capitalization, and special characters. If a code still doesn’t work, it may have expired or already been redeemed on your account. You can also try restarting the game and entering the code again.

What Rewards Can You Get From Drop a Fruit Codes?

Drop a Fruit codes can reward you with Coins, Luck Boosts and other valuable items. These rewards can help you unlock rarer fruits and improve your plot.

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Anime Dice codes:

title.rendered: Apple Intelligence on Apple Watch: All the new features in watchOS 27

content.rendered:
Apple is making the Apple Watch more intelligent with watchOS 27, and the biggest change is the arrival of Siri AI. Instead of relying only on basic voice commands, you can have more natural conversations with Siri, retrieve personal information, ask questions, and perform actions across apps directly from your wrist.

The update also improves Workout Buddy, makes Smart Stack suggestions more useful, and introduces a dedicated Siri app. Here’s everything you need to know about the new Apple Intelligence features in watchOS 27, compatible Apple Watch models, and the requirements for using them.

Which Apple Watch models support Apple Intelligence?

Not all Apple Watches will support the full Apple Intelligence suite. These features rely on advanced hardware, so compatibility is limited to watchOS 27-supported Apple Watch models:

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later
  • Apple Watch SE (3rd generation)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later

To use Apple Intelligence, your watch must be paired with one of the following iPhones running iOS 27:

  • iPhone 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 series and later models

Older iPhones, even if compatible with iOS 27, won’t enable these advanced AI features.

Important: Some features, such as Audio Intelligence, require the latest Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.

All the new Apple Intelligence features in watchOS 27

watchOS 27 builds on the intelligence features introduced in watchOS 26. Here’s what’s new and how the updated experience works.

1. Siri AI: A more capable assistant on your wrist

The biggest Apple Intelligence upgrade in watchOS 27 is Siri AI. Apple is moving beyond simple commands toward more natural conversations and contextual assistance.

For example, you can ask Siri AI an open-ended question, brainstorm workout ideas, or get information about a topic you’re curious about. Siri can also help you find information you’ve previously saved, such as a door code in a note or details related to an upcoming trip.

The feature I like best is that Siri AI can perform actions across supported apps. You could ask it to play a song someone recommended, check upcoming events, or adjust your Activity ring goal without manually navigating through several screens.

This makes the Apple Watch more useful when pulling out your iPhone isn’t convenient. Moreover, you can find all your conversations in the dedicated Siri app.

A few things to know: Siri AI is currently in beta and rolling out in English. Availability can vary by region and other requirements.

2. Audio Intelligence: Your Apple Watch can hear, recognize, and remember

One of the most interesting additions to the latest Apple Watch lineup is Audio Intelligence, a new category of Apple Intelligence features that help you recognize sounds, identify music, and recall conversations without constantly reaching for your iPhone.

You get four new smart features for your Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4:

  • Sound Recognition: Your Apple Watch can detect sounds such as sirens, alarms, and doorbells and notify you when they occur. This is particularly useful when you’re listening to music or for people who are deaf or hard of hearing.
  • Music Recognition: Powered by Shazam, this feature automatically identifies songs playing nearby and displays their titles and artists in Smart Stack. It can also identify music offline and provide results when you’re back online.
  • Live Rewind: It lets you revisit the last 15 seconds of speech as text when you miss something in a conversation. You can view the snippet, ask Siri about it, or save it for later.
  • Siri Recap: Siri creates AI-generated summaries of conversations to help you remember important topics and details. You can view, edit, save, or export summaries to apps such as Notes and Journal.

Note: Live Rewind and Siri Recap are planned for beta availability later in 2026, initially in English.

3. Workout Buddy gets smarter

Workout Buddy arrived in watchOS 26, and watchOS 27 makes it more informative and flexible. It uses your fitness history and workout data to deliver personalized, spoken motivation during supported workouts. Rather than offering only generic encouragement, it can provide insights based on your progress.

For example, Workout Buddy can highlight improvements in your pace, distance, and workout duration. It can also use relevant fitness information to make its feedback feel more connected to your training.

Apple has introduced two notable improvements in watchOS 27:

  • More detailed fitness insights: Workout Buddy can give you feedback based on your progress across pace, distance, and workout duration.
  • Workout Buddy without your iPhone nearby: You can receive motivational feedback during supported workouts without carrying your paired iPhone, provided you have the required Wi-Fi or cellular connectivity.

Workout Buddy is also available in Spanish in addition to English.

Supported Workouts: Outdoor/Indoor Run and Walk, Outdoor/Indore Cycle, HIIT, Hiking, Elliptical, Strair Stepper, and Functional and Traditional Strength Training.

4. Live Translation: Break language barriers

With watchOS 26, your Apple Watch becomes a language translator right on your wrist with the Live Translation feature in the Messages app.  

It translates conversations into your preferred language in real-time, allowing you to easily communicate with people who speak different languages. Moreover, when you reply, your message is translated into the recipient’s language as well.  

Languages at launch: English (US, UK), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Spain), and Chinese (Simplified).

5. Send Genmoji: Custom emojis with personality

You can now send Genmoji—custom AI-generated emojis created on your iPhone—directly from your Apple Watch. Once you create a Genmoji, it syncs to your Apple Watch via iCloud, appearing in the Messages app’s emoji picker. You can tap to send them, just like regular emojis. 

Apple also upgraded Genmoji with iOS 26 by combining emojis, typing a description, or blending two emojis to make a unique one. Therefore, this feature lets you make conversations more expressive. 

6. Smart Actions in Messages: Context-aware replies

 

The Messages app in watchOS 26 becomes much smarter, thanks to on-device machine learning. It suggests actions based on message context, like offering to share your location when someone texts, “Are you home yet?”

It even helps in group chats. For instance, if someone sends you a dinner bill, your watch might prompt you to pay them via Apple Cash with one tap.

7. Smart Stack gets smarter suggestions

Smart Stack is designed to surface useful widgets without requiring you to search through your apps. In watchOS 27, its suggestions become more context-aware.

Your Apple Watch can surface relevant information based on your routines, location, and upcoming events.

For example, Smart Stack might suggest:

  • A birthday message when a close contact has a birthday.
  • The location of your parked car.
  • A change to your sleep alarm before a selected holiday.
  • A transit card when you may need to check its balance.

These suggestions make it easier to reach the information you need without opening each app manually. The goal is to make the watch feel more proactive while keeping its interface simple.

8. Smart call management: AI handles the interruptions

watchOS 26 brings Hold Assist and Call Screening directly to your wrist, so you can manage calls hands-free.

  • Hold Assist: If you’re on hold waiting for a live agent, Hold Assist recognizes when the agent is ready and notifies you to return to the call. This means you can put your watch down and focus on something else without missing the moment the agent picks up. 
  • Call Screening: For unknown callers, Call Screening automatically answers the call and asks the caller to state their name and reason for calling. Your watch then alerts you with the details, so you can decide whether to take the call or decline it. 

9. Smarter notifications: Sound that adapts

Your Apple Watch now adjusts the notification sound based on your environment. In quiet rooms, it reduces volume to avoid startling you. In louder areas, it boosts alerts so you never miss a ping.

This smart adjustment is made possible by the Apple Watch’s onboard ambient noise detection.

Bonus: Redesigned Health app with Apple Intelligence

Apple is redesigning the Health app to make health data easier to understand using Apple Intelligence. It helps turn information from your iPhone, Apple Watch, and connected devices into personalized insights and recommendations.

Insights Tab: The new Insights tab highlights important information about heart health, sleep, fitness, vital signs, and cycle tracking. Its For You section also recommends relevant health articles and practical lifestyle improvements.

Longevity Tab: This tab helps you understand long-term health trends across areas such as heart health, sleep, movement, nutrition, and hearing. It also introduces Health Age, which compares selected metrics, including VO₂ max, resting heart rate, sleep, and heart rate variability (HRV), with patterns associated with your chronological age.

At-Home Movement Assessments: Using your iPhone camera and Apple Watch, you can assess flexibility, strength, balance, movement mechanics, and VO₂ max. Apple says these assessments run on-device without recording, storing, or sharing video.

Based on all your results, the Health app can suggest relevant exercises, educational videos, and articles to help you improve specific areas of your well-being.

Availability: The redesigned Health app is coming to compatible Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhones and iPads, initially in US English. Health Age requires an Apple Watch, and certain features have additional device and regional requirements.

Apple Intelligence is becoming more useful on Apple Watch

watchOS 27 builds on the foundation introduced in watchOS 26. Siri AI is the headline addition, offering more natural conversations, personal-context assistance, and actions across apps. Meanwhile, Workout Buddy provides more detailed fitness feedback, Smart Stack becomes more proactive, and the new Siri app makes conversations easier to revisit.

The latest Apple Watch models also benefit from broader improvements to health tracking, interface usability, and everyday interactions.

However, not every feature is available on every watch, and language, region, hardware, and connectivity requirements still matter. Checking those requirements before upgrading or buying a new Apple Watch is the best way to understand which capabilities you’ll actually be able to use.

Which watchOS 27 feature are you most excited to try? Let us know in the comments!

title.rendered: Upcoming Apple products in 2026: Full list of what to expect

content.rendered:
Apple’s 2026 product lineup has turned out to be much bigger than a typical iPhone refresh.

After months of rumors, Apple has officially unveiled a brand-new smart display lineup called HomeView, along with the HomePod mini 2, a new Apple TV 4K, and an updated Siri Remote. We also got the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, its first foldable iPhone Duo, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.

That is only part of the story. Apple has already refreshed several Macs and iPads earlier this year, including MacBook Neo, MacBook Pro M5 Pro & M5 Max, MacBook Air M5, iPad Air M4, Mac mini M6 & M5 Pro, and Mac Studio M5 Max & M5 Ultra.

However, the list doesn’t end here. Here, I have shared all the upcoming Apple products that are still rumored or expected so you can quickly see what you should still wait for.

Apple products still expected later in 2026

Apple’s September event has already eliminated many of the biggest unknowns surrounding its 2026 lineup.

However, several products are still expected or rumored at the end of the year, from October to December, with no officially confirmed launch dates.

iPad mini with OLED

The next iPad mini is expected to move from an LCD panel to OLED, which would bring deeper blacks, better contrast, and improved HDR performance.

Apple could also upgrade the chip to a newer A19 Pro or A20 Pro processor, giving the compact tablet considerably more performance for Apple Intelligence and demanding apps.

Other rumored changes include improved water resistance and a vibration-based speaker system.

MacBook Pro with M6 Pro and M6 Max

Apple has already introduced the M6 chip in the Mac mini, so the next major step is bringing M6-class silicon to Apple’s professional laptops.

A redesigned MacBook Pro with M6 Pro and M6 Max chips is expected later in 2026. Reports have suggested a thinner, lightweight design, OLED displays, and potentially even a touchscreen, packed with next-gen features like cellular support.

If the redesigned MacBook Pro arrives this year, it could become one of Apple’s biggest Mac upgrades in several years.

iMac with M6

The next-gen 24-inch iMac is also expected to receive an M6 update with some new color options.

The main upgrade is likely to be internal rather than a dramatic redesign. Apple could use the M6 chip to deliver faster CPU, GPU, and AI performance while retaining the colorful all-in-one design that defines the current iMac.

A larger iMac or an OLED iMac remains a longer-term possibility rather than something I would count on for 2026.

iPad 12th Generation with Apple Intelligence

The Apple iPad 12th generation is expected to be Apple’s next entry-level tablet.

Rumors suggest it will feature a powerful A18 chip, which could enable Apple Intelligence AI features, Stage Manager 2, Wi-Fi 7, improved multitasking, and smoother everyday performance.

The device is also expected to include around 8GB of RAM, making it better suited for productivity, creative apps, and advanced iPadOS features.

While the overall design may remain similar to the current model, the new iPad could still offer an 11-inch Liquid Retina display, 12MP cameras, and Touch ID, along with improved efficiency.

Apple Home and Display Products

  • Apple Studio Display 2 with mini‑LED backlighting, ProMotion support (120Hz), Thunderbolt 5, and 5K resolution.

Apple products that could arrive in 2027 or later

Not everything Apple is working on is necessarily coming in 2026. These products are strongly rumored but don’t yet have a clear launch quarter:

MacBook Ultra

The rumored MacBook Ultra might turn out to be the company’s most ambitious Mac laptop yet. Current design reports point to a thinner body, OLED display, and touchscreen support, potentially making it the first Mac with a touchscreen.

The laptop is also rumored to replace the familiar display notch with an iPhone-style Dynamic Island, while Apple could explore built-in cellular connectivity. Recent reports suggest the first model may use M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.

The MacBook Ultra is expected to sit above the MacBook Pro in Apple’s lineup and be more expensive. The launch date is not clear, but according to current information, the product might be announced in late 2026 or early 2027.

AirPods Pro with Cameras

AirPods Pro with on-device cameras for visual AI features and improved spatial intelligence are expected to debut this year.

Apple is reportedly developing multiple versions of camera-equipped AirPods, including models identified by the codenames B790 and B798. A leaked video found in macOS Tahoe 26.7 appears to demonstrate the technology, showing a user looking at a book while Siri uses Visual Intelligence to recognize and remember it.

Apple Glasses / AR Wearables

Apple’s long-anticipated AR glasses may be unveiled, potentially late in 2026 or teased for a 2027 ship window.

AR devices

  • Targeting a 2027 launch, Vision Air could serve as a lightweight and budget-friendly alternative to Vision Pro. It is expected to be ~40% lighter with a magnesium alloy or plastic frame and likely powered by an A-series chip.

Why 2026 is such an important year for Apple

Apple’s strategy in 2026 is shaping up to be more aggressive, category-expanding, and ecosystem-wide than in typical years. The combination of staple updates (like iPhones and Macs), breakthrough category bets (foldables, Apple Glasses, smart home hubs), and AI-oriented experiences places 2026 as a pivotal year for consumer hardware and Apple’s long-term vision.

Bookmark this article; we’ll keep it updated as more rumors and confirmations roll in. Got a favorite from the list? Let us know in the comments!

title.rendered: Apple announces HomeView, a $299 smart display for the home

content.rendered:
Apple has announced HomeView, a 7-inch smart display that sits on a table or mounts on a wall. Both versions cost $299 in the US. Apple made the announcement on October 13, the day of its “Welcome home” event, and pre-orders open today.

A 7-inch screen for a shelf or a wall

The tabletop model pairs the display with a domed speaker base. Apple says it can sit on a table “as the center of the home,” while the wall-mounted version fits spots like the entryway or hallway. Both use the same 7-inch Liquid Retina display. Earlier design reports had put the screen at 6 inches, so Apple’s spec settles the question.

Sound comes from two custom full-range drivers in the display on the tabletop model. The base adds a down-firing woofer and two force-cancelling passive radiators. The wall-mounted model has two custom drivers of its own. The device uses the A18 chip that earlier reports had named.

Up to six people get their own Home Screen

HomeView recognizes up to six people by face, and each one gets a personal Home Screen with their own apps and widgets. Personal content in apps like Messages and Calendar only appears when the enrolled person is recognized. Apple also says data processed in Secure Exclaves cannot be accessed by the HomeView software, apps, the user, or Apple.

Apple’s Greg Joswiak, senior vice president of Worldwide Marketing, put the idea this way: “Apple HomeView is designed to be shared by everyone in the home yet feel completely personal to each user.”

Camera recognition needs an iCloud+ plan

Not all Apple HomeView features are free. Camera recognition runs on a supported iCloud+ subscription. With one, HomeView can recognize people, familiar faces, pets, packages, and vehicles on compatible cameras. It also gives video descriptions for HomeKit Secure Video footage. Apple says the number of cameras supported depends on the plan.

HomeView can also detect the sound of smoke or carbon monoxide alarms and alert users on their iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch. It works with Matter and other Works with Apple Home accessories.

Apple is also launching a separate lineup of smart-home accessories, the Apple Home Collection, designed with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric. It starts in December, and select accessories follow in early 2027.

Siri AI is English-only and in beta

Siri AI is in beta in HomeView software version 27.2 and works only in English for now. Canadian French will arrive through a free software update. Earlier reporting on Apple’s J490 home hub had already described a device built around Siri AI.

Siri has limits. Some Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models have daily usage limits, and Apple says expanded access will cost a fee in the future. Personal context requests need a paired iPhone or iPad with Apple Intelligence. Expressive Siri voices need an iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Air, or iPhone 17 Pro, or an iPad with an M4 chip or later and at least 12GB of memory.

Apple is not selling HomeView in the European Union because Siri AI is not currently available in iOS there.

Pre-orders open today, and shipping starts November 13

Both models carry the same US price and come in different colors.

Both models ship on November 13 in Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, the UK, and the US. Power Mount accessories start at $59.95 for the USB-C Wall Connector and $79.95 for the AC Wired model. The PoE Wired model costs $129.95 and arrives in early 2027.

Two things to check before pre-ordering

The EU gap and the iCloud+ requirement matter most. If you live in the EU, HomeView is not an option for now. If you want the camera features, factor in an iCloud+ plan and check how many cameras that plan covers.

On apps, Apple names Apple Music and Apple TV, plus compatible third-party audio and video apps. The announcement does not mention an App Store.

Much of the earlier reporting holds up. The HomeView name, the A18 chip, the tabletop colors, and a mid-November launch all match Apple’s announcement. A July Bloomberg report had put the launch between October 2026 and early 2027, and the November 13 date now settles the timing.

title.rendered: Fortnite Horde Rush: What it is, how to play, and rewards list

content.rendered:
Horde Rush mode has returned once again to Fortnite, thanks to the Fortnitemares update earlier in October. This is the first appearance of the fast-paced game mode since October 2025, when it was rebranded as “Demon Rush” and bore identical themes stemming from the game’s collab with K-Pop Demon Hunters. The current Horde Rush rendition is expected to only be available in the game till the end of Fortnitemares 2026, which is October 31, 2026.

If you are into the idea of facing increasingly dangerous waves of CPU-controlled enemies while collecting weapon upgrades and racking up score multipliers, Horde Rush should be the ideal mode. It is a high-adrenaline Fortnite map with an emphasis on all-out action and on accumulating the highest score possible. Below, you can learn more about it, from what the mode consists of to which currently available quests are associated with it.

What is the objective in Fortnite Horde Rush?

Your initial goal in the Horde Rush mode is to survive through the hordes of monsters, while simultaneously staying clear of the Storm. To help you with this, you have access to a range of weapons, which can be purchased from Vending Machines and upgraded at Upgrade Benches using Monster Parts.

On top of these weapons, there are boosts called “Perks” that you can equip, allowing you to keep up with the increasing intensity of successive enemy waves. Alternatively, you may also choose to put yourself at a disadvantage instead, in exchange for more generous rewards, by using the Cursed Statue, which amps up the match’s difficulty.

After you successfully clear some rounds in a match, you will enter a boss fight with The Final Peel. Once you beat this too, Fortnite Horde Rush essentially becomes an endless mode, where there is no longer a set objective. In other words, you can keep eliminating enemies and increasing your score for as long as you can, in order to get the best high score on the leaderboard or beat your own past record.

How to play Horde Rush in Fortnite

Accessing Horde Rush in Fortnite is a nearly instant task; from the “Play” tab, you just have to scroll sideways to find and select the desired mode. However, in case you can’t find it for some reason, there is another way to do it, as shown in the steps below.

  1. In the Play tab (Fortnite home menu), scroll down to the Discover section.
  2. Then, choose Horde Rush from the game modes categorized under “Featured By Epic”.
  3. Next, click on “Select“.
  4. At last, hit the Play button to start loading Horde Rush in Fortnite.

It’s also worth noting that, on the Horde Rush screen and right above the Play button, there is a “Fill” button that lets you pick your preferences for this game mode. Importantly, it pulls up a side-bar menu that has two settings: Privacy and Team Fill.

The former setting lets you determine if you want to play exclusively with your friends who are already waiting in the match lobby or freely connect with other Fortnite players for this mode. On the other hand, the latter setting lets you choose if you want to go solo or automatically connect with players to fill up vacant spots in the squad.

Fortnite Horde Rush quest rewards

Initially, there will only be three quests that will be showing up in the Quests tab for this game mode. However, as you tick these off, you will unlock more sets of Horde Rush quests, which are divided as “Nitemare One,” “Nitemare Two,” and so on. Some of these quest groups are scheduled for roll-out after certain time intervals, so more should become available as the season progresses.

*Quests in Nitemare Two (unlocked after completing quests in Nitemare One)

Wrapping up

The re-introduction of Horde Mode in its current form certainly brings a new layer of gameplay variety to Fortnite. Together with other official modes, such as Fortnite Battle Royale and Fortnite Reload, it offers players one more way to experience the highly popular online shooter with new rules and new objectives in place.

For regular players of the game, Fortnite Horde Rush—through its quests—is very useful to meet quest completion milestones. This can reasonably add to a player’s progress towards unlocking the free Jack-A-Nape skin, which requires 26 Fortnitemares quests to be completed before the event ends.

title.rendered: GTA 6 Cyberleek explained: What we know about the alleged build leak

content.rendered:
We’re just a few weeks away from the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6, and the hype surrounding the game is reaching new heights. Developer Rockstar Games has been ramping up its marketing efforts, revealing new details about the game to keep fans excited ahead of its launch. However, things have taken an unexpected turn as the infamous hacker group Cyberleek has resurfaced.

That’s right, after sharing a bunch of GTA 6 gameplay clips back in August, the group is now threatening to leak the game’s entire build before its official launch. So, what’s going on with these claims, and should you be concerned? Let’s take a closer look.

Is Cyberleek going to leak the entire GTA 6 build?

The Cyberleek group went quiet following its previous round of GTA 6 leaks in August. However, the hackers have made a comeback this week with some new gameplay footage. They’ve shared various scenes, including ones depicting Jason completely nude. However, if that wasn’t enough, the situation has now escalated.

As reported by IGN, Cyberleek has updated its website with a message claiming that it will release the complete GTA 6 build, including the story mode, if its cryptocurrency reaches a market cap of $30 million. The build is allegedly playable all the way to the end credits. Cyberleek has also claimed that it can provide footage of anything people want to see from the game to prove its claims.

There’s no denying that a leak of the complete GTA 6 build would be a massive blow to Rockstar Games. However, Cyberleek claims that Take-Two Interactive can prevent this from happening by releasing a physical disc version of the game and publicly apologizing for its actions. The group has repeatedly stated that its sole purpose in leaking GTA 6 is to protest Rockstar’s decision not to release a physical disc.

Unfortunately, the cryptocurrency being promoted by Cyberleek is well below its $30 million target. At the time of writing, its market cap stands at approximately $1.7 million. It’s unclear whether the group will follow through on its threat if the cryptocurrency fails to reach the stated milestone.

When it comes to the community, reactions to the situation are polarized. Some fans appreciate the additional gameplay footage and believe that the group has done more to hype up the game than Rockstar itself. However, many others have criticized Cyberleek, believing that the entire campaign is nothing more than a cryptocurrency scam. Some even argue that spoiling one of the most anticipated gaming releases in years just for financial gain is simply insane.

Cyberleek sets new milestones for GTA 6 leaks

While threatening to release the complete GTA 6 build, Cyberleek has also published a roadmap for sharing more gameplay footage. According to the group, each new leak will be unlocked when its promoted cryptocurrency reaches a specific market cap.

Here’s the complete list of milestones:

  1. Mini Tank: $5 million
  2. Tank: $9 million
  3. Police Shootout: $13 million
  4. Beach Massacre: $17 million
  5. Fighter Jet: $21 million
  6. Train vs. Train: $25 million

However, the planned gameplay leaks aren’t the group’s only claims. Cyberleek has also stated that the leaked GTA 6 build is approximately 200 GB in size. It’s unclear whether the final version of the game will have a similar file size.

It’s still unknown how Cyberleek managed to gain access to an allegedly playable version of GTA 6. Rockstar Games has previously addressed the leaks, but it has yet to respond to the group’s latest threats.

So, if you’re a fan of the franchise who wants to experience the game without spoilers, it might be worth being extra cautious online until GTA 6 launches on November 18, 2026.

Rounding up

The hacker group Cyberleek has resurfaced and threatened to release the complete GTA 6 build if its promoted cryptocurrency reaches a market cap of $30 million. The group has also shared additional gameplay footage, outlined new milestones for future leaks, and claimed that the game’s build is approximately 200 GB in size.

For now, these claims remain unverified, and Rockstar Games has yet to respond to the latest threats.

title.rendered: I tried Notes on Apple Watch, and watchOS 27 makes it more useful than ever

content.rendered:
Apple Watch has become much more useful for quick tasks, and the Notes app is a good example. Introduced with watchOS 26, Notes lets you create new notes, view existing ones, pin important information, and delete notes without reaching for your iPhone.

With watchOS 27, the Notes app remains a convenient way to capture information on the go. Whether I want to remember a shopping item, check a saved address, or quickly jot down an idea, having Notes on my wrist makes these small tasks easier. However, it is still a simplified experience rather than a full replacement for Notes on the iPhone or Mac.

Here’s what you can do in the Notes app on Apple Watch and how to use it like a pro.

What you can do with Notes on Apple Watch

The Notes app on Apple Watch focuses on quick access and basic note management. Here’s what you can do:

  • Create new notes using voice dictation, the onscreen keyboard, or Siri.
  • View existing notes that are synced from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac via iCloud.
  • Pin important notes so they stay at the top of your notes list.
  • Unlock locked notes (if you’ve enabled Face ID or passcode protection on your iPhone).
  • Tick off checklist items if your existing note includes tasks or to-do lists.
  • Delete notes you no longer need.

Your notes stay synced across supported devices signed in to the same Apple Account with iCloud Notes enabled. This means changes made on one device can appear on your other devices.

One of the biggest advantages is Siri support. You don’t even need to open the app—just raise your wrist and say, “Take a note,” and it’s saved instantly. This is especially handy when your hands are full, or you’re out for a run.

Notes app limitations on Apple Watch

Although Notes is useful for quick tasks, it has some limitations you should know about before relying on it as your primary note-taking tool.

  • You can’t edit existing notes: To change the text of an existing note, open it on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Your changes will sync through iCloud.
  • Some formatting isn’t visible: Tables, checklists, headings, and certain attachments, such as drawings and audio recordings, aren’t displayed on Apple Watch.
  • The experience is simplified: You can create new plain text notes and manage basic items, but you won’t get the complete editing and formatting tools available on your iPhone or Mac.

These limitations make sense for a small display. I would use the watch to capture quick thoughts and check information, then switch to my iPhone or Mac when I need to make more substantial changes.

Device and software requirements

To use the Notes app on Apple Watch, make sure the following are in place:

  • watchOS 26 or later installed on your Apple Watch.
  • An Apple Watch Series 6 or later, including Apple Watch SE (2nd gen) and all Apple Watch Ultra models.
  • An iPhone 11 or newer running iOS 26 or later to enable Siri support.
  • Notes is configured to sync across your devices via iCloud.
  • Siri language should match your device language for dictation to work properly.

How to use the Notes App on Apple Watch

Once your Apple Watch is updated to the latest watchOS version, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Notes app from the app grid or list view. It gets installed automatically with the watchOS 26 update.
  2. You’ll see a list of your synced notes, similar to how it appears on iPhone.
  3. Turn the Digital Crown to scroll through your notes. Pinned notes appear at the top of the list, followed by other notes sorted by date.
  4. Tap to open and view any note. Locked notes can be accessed by entering your passcode.

  5. To create a new note, tap the floating new note icon in the bottom-right corner.
  6. Use voice input, on-screen keyboard, or swipe typing to write your note.
  7. Tap Done to save the note.
  8. Swipe right on a note to see the Pin option.
  9. Swipe left on a note to see the Delete option.

That’s it! You can now manage your notes right from your wrist—quick, simple, and always accessible. Be careful when deleting notes because the action affects your synced Notes library. If you accidentally delete something, you can recover it from the Recently Deleted folder on your iPhone within 30 days.

I always ask Siri to start a new note. This is useful when you want to capture an idea quickly without manually opening the app.

Want more new features? Here’s everything new in watchOS 27.

How Notes sync across Apple devices

One of the most useful aspects of Notes on Apple Watch is its integration with iCloud. When you create a note or make a supported change on another device, the information can sync across your devices signed in to the same Apple Account.

To check your setup, open Settings on your iPhone, tap your Apple Account name, go to iCloud, and check that Notes is enabled.

If your notes aren’t appearing on your watch, first confirm that iCloud Notes is enabled and that your devices are signed in to the correct Apple Account. Also check your internet connection and give iCloud some time to sync.

Notes on Apple Watch in watchOS 27: Is it worth using?

The Notes app is a useful addition to Apple Watch, particularly if you already rely on Apple Notes across your devices. You can create quick notes, check saved information, pin important items, and delete unwanted notes without pulling out your iPhone.

However, I wouldn’t treat it as a complete note editor. The inability to edit existing notes and the limited support for formatting and attachments mean that longer notes are still easier to manage on an iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

For everyday reminders, short ideas, and quick reference information when your iPhone isn’t immediately within reach, Notes on Apple Watch is worth using.

title.rendered: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 is ending soon: Here’s when

content.rendered:
There’s no denying that Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, “Override,” has proven to be a blast. We’ve had a bunch of exciting crossovers with Cyberpunk 2077, Sonic the Hedgehog, Pac-Man, and many other franchises. On top of that, the season has also brought new game modes, events, Sprites, and POIs to keep players busy. If that wasn’t enough, Fortnitemares 2026 has taken things to the next level.

However, all good things must come to an end, and this season is no exception. Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 is set to conclude on October 31, 2026. So, if you’re wondering exactly what time the season ends and what you need to know before it wraps up, here’s everything you need to know.

Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 end date & time

So, when does Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 end? Well, as we’ve mentioned, it’s set to conclude on October 31, 2026. Although Epic Games hasn’t confirmed the exact end time yet, the season is expected to wrap up around 1:00 AM PT.

If you’re wondering what that means for your region, here’s a table to help you:

Keep in mind that once Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 comes to an end, any unclaimed Battle Pass rewards will become unavailable. The same goes for Fortnitemares and seasonal quests, which will also disappear from the game.

So, make sure you’ve reached Level 100 on the Battle Pass, claimed all your free Fortnitemares rewards, redeemed any available Admin Panel codes, and completed any remaining quests before the season ends.

As of now, Epic Games hasn’t confirmed whether the end of the season will feature a live event.

When does Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 5 begin?

Every season eventually comes to an end, but it also makes way for something new. With Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 wrapping up, players can look forward to the arrival of Chapter 7 Season 5. However, Epic Games hasn’t officially revealed the upcoming season’s name or what players can expect from it yet.

That said, we do have a few hints about what’s coming. According to reliable Fortnite leaker HYPEX on X, the upcoming season is expected to be a mini-season and could feature a crossover with none other than One Piece.

We can expect Epic Games to share more teasers and announcements as the next Fortnite season draws closer.

Wrapping up

Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4, “Override,” is all set to end on October 31, 2026. Rumors suggest that the next season will be shorter and might even feature a crossover with One Piece.

Until Epic Games shares more information, make sure you complete your Battle Pass and claim all available rewards before the current season ends.

FAQs

What time does Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 “Override” end?

Epic Games hasn’t mentioned a specific end time for Fortnite Chapter7 Season 4 “Override”. However, it’s expected to conclude around 1:00 AM PT on October 31, 2026.

Will Fortnitemares also conclude with Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4?

Yes, the Fortnitemares 2026 event will also come to an end on the same date as the current season.

title.rendered: I turned my loyalty cards and tickets into Apple Wallet passes: Here’s how

content.rendered:
We’ve all faced the hassle of carrying loyalty cards, tickets, or passes because they didn’t have an official Add to Apple Wallet button. So, forgetting the card meant losing the benefit. I’ve often wished there were an easier way to keep all these cards in one place, and iOS 27 offers a solution with its Create a Pass feature in Apple Wallet.

With this feature, you can create custom passes from photos, screenshots, or card details, and keep any cards on your iPhone even if their digital version isn’t available in the Wallet app. In this guide, I’ll show you how to add tickets, loyalty cards, gym memberships, and other useful cards to Apple Wallet.

What is Create a Pass in Apple Wallet?

Before iOS 27, adding a ticket or membership card to Apple Wallet often depended on whether the business supported Apple’s digital pass system. If it didn’t, you usually had to keep the physical card, save a screenshot, or open the company’s app whenever you needed it.

With iOS 27, Apple introduces a more flexible Create a Pass option. It lets you build a digital representation of a card or ticket and store it in the Wallet app. The best part is that I can create passes from photos or screenshots containing a barcode or QR code, or manually select a template and enter the details myself.

Here are some practical examples of what you can create:

  • Loyalty and rewards cards: Keep a store’s membership number or scannable loyalty code in Wallet.
  • Membership cards: Store compatible gym, library, or club membership details.
  • Event tickets: Create a pass containing a stable barcode or QR code from a ticket.
  • Gift cards: Keep a gift card’s details and supported code together.
  • Other useful passes: Organize certain coupons, insurance information, and other details using the available templates and fields.

The important distinction is that a custom pass is not necessarily an official pass issued by a business. It stores the information you provide, but the business still determines whether its barcode, QR code, or membership details are accepted.

What you need before creating an Apple Wallet pass

I recommend gathering everything you need before opening Wallet. It makes the process easier and reduces the chances of saving a pass with incorrect information.

You’ll need:

  • An iPhone running iOS 27 or later.
  • A physical card, photo, screenshot, or digital ticket.
  • A readable barcode or QR code if the business uses one.
  • The correct membership or ticket details, or other information you want to include.

There is one compatibility detail to remember. Apple’s photo-and-screenshot pass creation uses Visual Intelligence. So, you need an iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or iPhone 16 model or later, updated to iOS 27.

Manual pass creation is a separate workflow, so don’t assume that you can’t create passes on older iPhones.

How to create a custom pass in Apple Wallet

iOS 27 offers multiple ways to add any type of card and passes to your Wallet, similar to Google Wallet.

Method 1: Scanning the physical card

This is the first method I’d try to add a physical loyalty, membership, library, parking, or rewards card that has a barcode or QR code.

  1. Open the Wallet app on your iPhone and tap the Add (+) button.
  2. Look for Create a Pass and select it.
  3. Tap Continue to use Visual Intelligence.

    Image Credit: Macrumors
  4. Place the card on a flat surface, use good lighting, and make sure the barcode or QR code is visible. Avoid reflections, shadows, and blurry images.
  5. Tap the shutter to take a photo.

    Image Credit: Macrumors
  6. Now wait for your iPhone to identify the card and match it to a template.
  7. Review the following:
    • The business or membership name.
    • The membership or card number.
    • Any additional fields that were recognized.
    • The barcode or QR code, where supported.
  8. If everything looks right, tap Add.

    Image Credit: Macrumors

Your custom pass should now appear in Apple Wallet alongside your other passes. Open it whenever you need to present its details or code.

The Wallet app also offers an editing option to adjust the appearance and information. If you have several rewards cards, giving each pass a recognizable name and appearance helps you find the correct one. I will share the steps later in the post.

Method 2: Use a photo or screenshot

You don’t always need to start inside Wallet. If you already have a photo or screenshot of a ticket or membership card, you may try creating a pass from it.

This is especially useful for digital tickets received by email or membership cards that you have previously photographed.

  1. Take a photo or screenshot containing the barcode or QR code.
  2. Open the image in Photos.
  3. Tap the i button to open the photo’s information panel, or swipe up, and look for the Add Pass to Wallet option when iOS recognizes the code.
  4. Tap the option and follow the on-screen instructions.
  5. Review the details and save the pass by tapping Add.

If the button doesn’t appear, it doesn’t necessarily mean the image is unusable. Try the manual creation method described below.

Method 3: Create the pass manually

If automatic recognition doesn’t work or your iPhone doesn’t support Visual Intelligence, manual creation gives you another option.

Some airlines, event organizers, cinemas, and booking services provide an official Add to Apple Wallet button. When that option is available, use it first. The official pass may contain additional information or functionality that a manually created pass cannot reproduce.

But what if your ticket only arrives as a PDF or an email attachment?

Here’s what I would try:

  1. Open Wallet and tap the Add (+) button.
  2. Select Create a Pass.
  3. Tap Create Pass Manually.
  4. Choose a suitable template.
  5. Enter the relevant information and edit the available fields.
  6. Follow the available barcode or QR code options, then save the pass.

For example, you might create a custom pass for a local concert, a museum visit, or an event with a static admission code. I also use this method to save in-store gift card details.

Still, creating a custom pass in Wallet does not automatically turn it into a valid ticket. There are venues where the original ticket, an account-linked pass, an official barcode, or a changing code is needed. A custom pass may not work in those situations.

My recommendation: Keep the original photo or PDF file until you ensure that the saved pass contains all the necessary information. If a retailer offers passes via Apple Wallet, I would prefer the official pass.

How to edit or delete a custom pass in Apple Wallet

Creating the pass is only half the job. You may later want to correct a membership number, change the color, or remove an expired ticket.

To edit an Apple Wallet pass:

  1. Open Wallet and select the custom pass.
  2. Tap the More (three-dot) button.
  3. Choose Edit Pass from the menu.
  4. Edit the fields, like membership number, program name, etc.
  5. If you want to add more details, tap the Edit button > Add/Remove Fields. You may select Member status, Member since, Expires, VIN, etc. fields depending on the pass type.
  6. To change the appearance, tap the palette icon and select Background Color. Choose a color and texture you like.
  7. Tap the checkmark to save your changes.

You can use this workflow to make a pass easier to identify or correct details that were entered incorrectly.

Delete a custom pass:

To remove a pass you no longer need:

  1. Open Wallet and select the pass.
  2. Tap the More button.
  3. Select the Remove Pass option.
  4. Confirm the removal when prompted.

Deleting a custom pass from Wallet doesn’t cancel a membership, refund a ticket, or delete the underlying account with the business.

How to use your custom pass at a Store or Event

Once you’ve added a custom pass to Apple Wallet, using it is pretty straightforward.

Here’s how to use your pass when you are at the counter:

  1. Open Apple Wallet and select your custom pass.
  2. Show the barcode or QR code on the screen if the store or venue accepts it.
  3. If you need to refer to the original card, tap View Original Photo to open the photo or screenshot used to create the pass.

Another handy feature is Pass Details. Whenever I am filling out any form or need to use the card number, I open the pass and tap the three dots. Go to Pass Details to see the member number, merchant name, website, and other details, then copy them.

Things I learned while moving cards into Apple Wallet

Creating custom passes in Apple Wallet is a convenient way to keep all loyalty cards, membership cards, and tickets organized, especially when official Wallet support is missing. However, there are a few things worth knowing before you start moving everything into Wallet.

  • A clear photo makes a difference: While making a pass from a photo/screenshot, please be sure that the card info and the barcode are readable. Always verify the info before saving the pass.
  • “View Original Photo” can be useful: I like the idea of keeping the original card image accessible from the pass. It gives you another way to check the original details when the custom pass doesn’t show everything.
  • Dynamic codes are a different story: Some businesses refresh their membership or ticket codes regularly. A saved photo of an old code may not work, so the official app or pass is often the better option.
  • Keep your original cards for now: Before leaving a physical card at home, check whether the custom pass is accepted at checkout or entry. This is particularly important for event tickets and memberships.

Common problems when creating Apple Wallet passes

Creating a custom pass in Apple Wallet is fairly simple, but you might run into a few problems along the way. If you can’t create a pass, the barcode doesn’t scan, or the pass doesn’t work at checkout, here’s what you can try.

Final thoughts

The most useful thing about iOS 27’s Create a Pass feature is that it gives me another option when a business hasn’t provided an official Apple Wallet pass. Instead of keeping every loyalty card in my physical wallet or hunting through screenshots, I can try organizing compatible cards and tickets in one place.

Just remember to check whether your custom pass works before leaving the physical card at home. After all, the goal is to make your wallet lighter, not to get stuck at the checkout counter again!

acceptedAnswer.text: Not really. While a range of Kado Thorne cosmetics are up for grabs for those who complete certain quests, none of those items include the villain's original skin.

acceptedAnswer.text: Highly unlikely because, since its introduction in Chapter 4 Season 4, this skin has never returned in Fortnite via the Item Shop or any other means. However, a variant of the same, the Elite Kado Thorne skin, did come out as part of a cup reward earlier this month (no longer claimable).

title.rendered: Clover Time codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Clover Time Codes on October 19, 2026

Are you a fan of the Black Clover anime? If so, it’s time to give Clover Time on Roblox a shot! This anime-inspired game lets you become a powerful mage, unlock unique abilities, battle enemies, and level up your character to become stronger.

However, progressing through the game requires plenty of resources, including Chests, Crystal Mana, and Spins. Luckily, we’ve put together a list of the latest Clover Time codes that can reward you with these valuable items for free. Redeem them to unlock better abilities, strengthen your character, and progress faster!

All working Clover Time codes

  • SHADOW: 30 Crystal Mana Spins, 2 Stat Resets, and 50% XP for 30 minutes (NEW)
  • 15KLIKES: 25 Spins and 1 Special Spin (NEW)
  • 600KVISITS: 1 Special Spin, 10 Reset Stats, and 1 Big Chest (NEW)
  • 25KFAVSTY: 1 Special Spin, 15 Spins, and 5 Legendary Bait (NEW)
  • 10KLIKES: 25 Spins and 1 Medium Chest (NEW)
  • ANIMERETURNINGSEASON: 25 Spins (NEW)
  • TYFOR3KPLAYERS: 25 Spins and 1 Big Chest (NEW)
  • 20KFAVS: 20 Spins
  • 10KFAVS: 25 Spins and 5 Medium Chests
  • 5KLIKES: 3 Medium Chests, 1 Big Chest, and 15 Spins
  • 1KLIKES: 25 Spins, 1 Crystal Mana, and 1 Normal Chest
  • FIRSTSHUTDOWN: 25 Spins and 5 Crystal Mana
  • BETARELEASE: 1 Big Chest, 50 Spins, and 1 Crystal Mana

Expired or unverified Clover Time codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

If any of the working codes stop functioning, they may have expired or reached their redemption limit.

How to redeem Clover Time codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem The Company codes:

  1. Fire up Clover Time on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click the Menu button on the left side of your screen.
  4. Click Settings, paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Clover Time codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for Clover Time codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Clover Time Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Racket Rivals codes, Komorebi Prison codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Why Are My Clover Time Codes Not Working?

Make sure you’ve entered the code exactly as shown in our list, including the correct spelling, capitalization, and special characters. If a code still doesn’t work, it may have expired or already been redeemed on your account. You can also try restarting the game and entering the code again.

What Rewards Can You Get From Clover Time Codes?

Clover Time codes can reward you with free Spins, Special Spins, Chests, Crystal Mana, Stat Resets, Boosts, and other valuable items. These rewards can help you unlock new abilities, improve your character, and progress faster without spending additional resources.

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Racket Rivals Codes on October 19, 2026

Get ready for some fast-paced racket action in Racket Rivals on Roblox! This exciting game lets you go head-to-head against other players in intense racket matches, unlock different rackets, use special abilities, and sharpen your skills to dominate the court.

Of course, you’ll need plenty of resources to unlock new gear and progress through the game faster. That’s where Racket Rivals codes come in! We’ve put together a list of the latest working codes that reward you with free Yen, Bundles, and other valuable items. Make sure to redeem them before they expire to get an edge over the competition.

All working Racket Rivals codes

  • WITCHING: 750 Yen (Requires level 20 to redeem) (NEW)
  • HOUR: 750 Yen (Requires level 20 to redeem) (NEW)
  • HONKING: 1,500 Yen
  • resetstats: Statistics Reset
  • FLICK: 750 Yen
  • 500M: Free bundle
  • ORTREAT: 750 Yen

These are the currently listed active Racket Rivals codes. Be sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as they can expire without warning.

Expired Racket Rivals codes

300MVISITS, 500M, AFK, APOLOGY, APOLOGYFORDELAY, BALANCE, BIG, BIGRANKED, BOOST, BUGS, CARD, CASTLE, COMMUNITY19, COMPETE, COSMIC, CREATECLUB, CRIMSON, DASH, DIVINE, ESLASGIFT, FIXES, FLEXURPACK, FLICK, FOOTBALL, FREE126, FREE127, FREE128, FREE129, FREE130, FREEADMIN, FREEJIN, FRIENDSHIP, GAME, GOOFY, GRIN, HALLOWEEN, HONKIN, INPROGRESS, IZUMA, JESTER, LEVIATHAN, LOW, MECHAWK, MERRYCHRISTMAS, MISTAWORLDWIDE, MODE, MUTATION, NEWSHUTTLE, NOWAYFIFTYK, ORTREAT, PATCHES, PAWFEST, PHANTOM, PHARAOH, RACE, RACKETSEEKER, RACKETSKINS, RAIN, RANKED5, RANKEDSOLO, REDENVELOPE, REFINE, RESTRUCTURING, RFIFTEEN, RM_5, RUBYCLASH, SAMURAI, SANTAISHERE, SCORE, SCREENS, SEASON2BP, SEASON5, SECRETSHRED, SELECTION, SKINSSS, SL3EPY, SOCCER, SOCCERMODE, SORRYRANKED, SORRYREBOOT, SPACE, SPIRIT10, SPOOKY, SPOOKYLORD, SPRINGLUCK, TASK80, TIDEWALL, TOKEN, TOONY, TOUCHGRASS, TRADING, TRADINGSOON, UPDATE10, UPDATE12, UPDATE13, UPDATE13V1, UPDATE14, UPDATE14V1, UPDATE15, UPDATE4, UPDATE5, UPDATE6, UPDATE7, UPDATE8, UPDATE9, UPDATEONE, UPDATETHREE, UPDATETWO, USEMATCHMAKING, WEEK2

How to redeem Racket Rivals codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes is only half the battle! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Fortunately, the process is straightforward and takes just a few minutes. Follow these steps to redeem Racket Rivals codes:

  1. Fire up Racket Rivals on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click the Shop icon and choose the Codes option.
  4. Paste a working code and click Submit to claim your reward.

Once you’ve successfully redeemed a code, the rewards should be added to your account automatically.

Where to find more Racket Rivals codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Racket Rivals codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

Here are a few ways to stay updated on the latest codes:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Racket Rivals Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Racket Rivals codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Komorebi Prison codes, Clover Time codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Why Are My Racket Rivals Codes Not Working?

Make sure you’ve entered the code exactly as shown in our list, including the correct spelling and capitalization. If a code still doesn’t work, it may have expired or already been redeemed on your account. You can also try restarting the game and entering the code again.

What Can You Get From Racket Rivals Codes?

Racket Rivals codes can reward you with free Yen, Bundles, and other in-game items. These rewards can help you unlock new gear, improve your gameplay, and progress faster without spending additional resources.

Update: Verified the latest Komorebi Prison Codes on October 19, 2026

Craving some action behind bars? It’s time to give Komorebi Prison a shot! This Roblox game throws you into a prison where you’ll fight other inmates and guards to prove who’s really in charge.

Your fighting style plays a major role in how each battle unfolds, making it crucial to have the right one. To help you out, we’ve put together a list of the latest Komorebi Prison codes that reward you with free rerolls. You can use these rerolls to unlock new fighting styles, improve your combat abilities, and keep your enemies guessing!

All working Komorebi Prison codes

  • TIMED: 25 Rerolls (NEW)
  • GANGWARS: 25 Rerolls (NEW)
  • PARRYFIX: 25 Rerolls (NEW)
  • BUGFIXES: 68 Rerolls (NEW)
  • ELORESET: 25 Rerolls (NEW)
  • BASKETBALL: 50 Rerolls (NEW)

These are the currently listed active Komorebi Prison codes. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Komorebi Prison codes

ANTICHEAT, BIRTHDAY, BOO, BUFFS, CELL, CODE, COMBAT, DAILYREWARDS, HALLOWEEN, LENTA, MILLIONVISITS, MINIFIXLOL192293, MINIGAMES, MYERS, NERFS, ONETHOUSANDCCU, OR, PATCHES, QUICKPATCH, REROLLS, TREAT, TRICK, TWENTYK, UNBANNED, UPDATE, WEAREBACK

How to redeem Komorebi Prison codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process is simple and only takes a few minutes.

Follow these steps to redeem Komorebi Prison codes:

  1. Open Komorebi Prison on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click the Menu icon on the left side of the screen and open the Codes tab.
  4. Paste a working code into the URL tab and click Redeem Code to claim your reward.

Once you’ve successfully redeemed a code, the rewards should be added to your account automatically.

Where to find more Komorebi Prison codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Komorebi Prison codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

Here are a few ways to stay updated on the latest codes:

  • Join the official Discord server: Head over to the Komorebi Prison Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Keep an eye on the game’s official Roblox page for updates and announcements.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Komorebi Prison codes become available, so you don’t have to search for them yourself.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Racket Rivals codes, Clover Time codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

Why Are My Komorebi Prison Codes Not Working?

Make sure you’ve entered the code exactly as shown in our list, including the correct spelling and capitalization. If a code still doesn’t work, it may have expired or already been redeemed on your account. You can also try restarting the game and entering the code again.

What Are Rerolls Used for in Komorebi Prison?

Rerolls allow you to unlock different fighting styles in Komorebi Prison. Each fighting style offers unique combat abilities, helping you experiment with different strategies and improve your chances of winning fights.

title.rendered: No Man’s Sky is coming to iPhone and iPad for $19.99

content.rendered:
No Man’s Sky is coming to iPhone and iPad, and the App Store listing shows an expected release date of October 29, 2026. You can download it free and play the opening before you pay. The full game is a one-time $19.99 unlock, and the listing says that includes 10 years of updates.

The game is a space exploration and survival title set in a procedurally generated universe, so the planets are created by the game rather than hand-built. Hello Games released it in 2016 on PC and PlayStation 4. Critics were split at launch, and the studio kept adding to the game afterward. The listing says the iPhone and iPad version includes all major updates since launch, including the Cosmos update, which is why the 10-year promise has real material behind it.

That also makes it a bigger commitment than a few-dollar iPhone game. The paid picks in this indie roundup, such as Monument Valley at $3.99, cost a few dollars. No Man’s Sky asks for a lot more, and big console-style games on iPhone are still the exception, so this one matters more than its price tag suggests.

What your device needs

You need iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 and a device with an A12 Bionic chip or newer, which covers the iPhone XS and later models. The App Store lists the game at 3.8 GB, so clear room before you download. The iPhone and iPad requirements sit on one listing, so one app covers both devices. The listing only mentions English.

On an iPhone, 3.8 GB is a serious chunk of storage for one game. The iPad makes more sense if you have one that qualifies, since a game built around long exploration sessions usually benefits from a bigger screen.

What the listing leaves out

The listing describes a shared universe where every other player lives in the same galaxy, and it lists Game Center support, which ties your games to friends, achievements, and leaderboards. It doesn’t say what’s left out of the iPhone version, and the game’s official site doesn’t spell it out either. Until Hello Games does, treat any list of missing features as unconfirmed.

The iPad promise took a long time

An Apple version was announced at WWDC 2022, with an iPad release promised for late that year. The Mac version arrived in 2023. Now the iPhone and iPad version has an App Store page and a date, which makes this a long wait for anyone who has been asking for it since 2022.

The free start is the smart way in. Play the opening, see whether the game grabs you, and buy it only if you’d happily spend more than a weekend in it. At $19.99 and 3.8 GB, that’s the test that matters.

title.rendered: Apple’s new Safari page leads with battery life and privacy against Chrome

content.rendered:
Apple has a new Safari page, and it makes one argument from top to bottom: Chrome is worse for your Mac’s battery, your page speed, and your privacy. The page is headlined “Stay on Safari,” and 9to5Mac reports two new YouTube videos pushing the same message.

The numbers are the easiest part of the pitch to over-read, so it’s worth looking at what sits behind them.

Five extra hours of video is a single-laptop test

Apple says Safari gives you up to five more hours of video streaming on a Mac than Chrome. The footnote explains the setup: a 15-inch MacBook Air with an M5 chip and 16GB of memory, playing 1080p video on battery power, tested in August 2026. Apple compared prerelease Safari 27.0 with Chrome 151.

The Safari vs Chrome guide leans on hands-on impressions and doesn’t measure battery life, so Apple’s published setup at least gives you something to check. It’s still one laptop, one kind of video, and prerelease software, which is the best-case version of Safari. If you watch a lot of video on a Mac, test the claim yourself once the public release is out.

Speed claims come from benchmarks and a snapshot of 12 sites

Apple says Safari loads frequently visited sites up to 35% faster than Chrome on a Mac. That number comes from 12 popular websites, tested on snapshot versions of those sites under simulated network conditions. Apple also cites three browser benchmarks, JetStream 3.0, MotionMark 1.3.2, and Speedometer 3.1, where it says Safari scored higher on average than Firefox, Chrome, and Edge at the time of testing. The “world’s fastest browser” line comes from those results across Mac, iPad Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, Windows, and Android devices.

Benchmarks tell you how the engine performs. The 35% tells you about twelve pages. Your experience depends on the sites you open every morning and the network they load over, so the number will feel different from one person to the next.

Privacy is the strongest part of the pitch

This argument doesn’t depend on a lab. Apple says Chrome “lets more third-party trackers follow you across the web and collect and sell your data to advertisers.” Safari blocks third-party cookies by default, and its Intelligent Tracking Prevention is designed to stop data-collection companies from profiling you. Apple also says Safari blocks known trackers in Private Browsing.

A privacy default doesn’t tell you about the rest of your setup. Chrome users who depend on specific extensions or Google account sync should check those before switching. Safari also isn’t on Windows. Windows users can sync bookmarks through iCloud for Windows instead.

Notify Me and tab grouping need Apple Intelligence

Apple’s two standout features are Notify Me, which checks a page for changes such as a price or availability update, and Organize by topic, which groups your open tabs by subject. Both run on Apple Intelligence, which needs an iPhone 16 or later, an iPhone 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max, or specific iPads, Macs, Apple Vision Pro, or Apple Watch models.

Some of the server-side features have daily usage limits. Apple says expanded access “will be available for a fee in the future.” That’s the line to read twice. Right now those features don’t carry a fee, but Apple has already said more access will cost money.

Safari makes a fair case on privacy. The battery claim is worth testing if you watch a lot of video on a laptop, and the speed number is the one to ignore until you’ve tried your own sites. Give Safari a week on your Mac, keep an eye on that fee line, and decide after that.

excerpt.rendered: Apple is pushing Chrome users to Safari on battery, speed and privacy. The numbers come from Apple’s own tests, and some newer Safari features need Apple Intelligence.

title.rendered: Apple’s Diwali AirPods 5 costs the same as the regular case in India

content.rendered:
Apple’s Special Edition AirPods 5 costs ₹17,900 in India, the same as the regular AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. That means the festive design doesn’t add to the bill. If you were already going to buy that case, pick this one. If you still need to decide between the base model and the case, the AirPods 5 breakdown covers what the case adds.

Underneath, it’s the same AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case. The real difference is a festive engraving on the case. Apple’s India page calls it “festive engraving” and doesn’t say more. Coverage describes a rangoli-style pattern wrapped around a heart-eyes emoji, which matches the product image Apple published. It’s a small, playful touch on something most people carry every day.

The sale runs from October 11 to November 11, 2026, or until supplies last. You can buy it at Apple Store locations, on the Apple Store online, or by phone. The page lists EMI from ₹1,533 a month, and three months of Apple Music free for new subscribers, then ₹139 a month.

Two units, no stacking, and narrower card offers

You can buy up to two pairs per customer. The offer can’t be combined with other AirPods offers, and it doesn’t work with Apple’s business, education, or corporate employee purchase plans.

Card deals come with conditions. No Cost EMI runs on 3, 6, 9, and 12-month plans with qualifying cards, but AirPods are limited to the 3- and 6-month plans. Instant cashback only works with American Express, Axis Bank, and ICICI Bank cards, on a transaction of at least ₹10,001, and it’s capped at two orders in any rolling 90-day window. If you’re paying with another card, none of that applies. Business customers don’t qualify for either card offer.

Replacements may not keep the design

Apple says it may replace or repair the special edition with the standard AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case, “subject to supply.” That’s the detail to read before buying. If you’re paying for the engraving, a replacement may not carry it.

Before you book a repair, check the battery levels. A low reading on its own is not a fault, and a quick check can save a trip. If a bud is missing rather than broken, the Find My steps come first.

Free art sessions, in selected countries

Coverage also describes free digital art workshops from October 14 to November 9. Artist Arushi Kathuria teaches participants to draw rangoli-style patterns in Procreate on an iPad, using a brush meant to mimic colored powder. The sessions run in India and in selected locations in the United States, Canada, Malaysia, and Singapore. Apple’s India product page doesn’t mention them, so check Apple’s event listings before you plan around one.

If you already wanted the AirPods 5 with the charging case, the Diwali design is a nice extra at no added cost. If you didn’t, a festive engraving isn’t a reason to buy them.

title.rendered: 99 Nights In The Forest Deer skin arrives in Fortnite: Here’s how to get it

content.rendered:
The iconic deer antagonist of 99 Nights In The Forest, simply known as The Deer, has landed in Fortnite as a skin. This is the latest of the horror franchise collabs that the online multiplayer title has been delivering throughout the October-long Fortnitemares event.

For those unaware, 99 Nights In The Forest is a co-op survival horror Roblox game developed by Grandma’s Favourite Games. As such, it is sort of a unique team-up that brings two of the biggest sandbox platforms in gaming today, Fortnite and Roblox, together in a first-of-its-kind crossover.

Being part of a limited-time promotion, the Deer skin, priced at 1,500 V-Bucks in the Item Shop, is available until October 16, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. Alternatively, it can also be obtained via the 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle, which also comes with some themed extras and is selling for 2,000 V-Bucks during the same period.

Steps to claim the 99 Nights In The Forest Deer skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the “99 Nights In The Forest” section.
  3. Finally, select and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

All 99 Nights In The Forest cosmetics in Fortnite

1. The Deer

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also comes with: Old Sack
Also included in: 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle

2. Old Sack back bling

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also included in: 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle

3. Old Axe pickaxe

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also included in: 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle

4. Taming Flame emote

Price: 400 V-Bucks
Also included in: 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle

5. The Deer’s Eyes wrap

Price: 500 V-Bucks
Also included in: 99 Nights In The Forest Bundle

Rounding up

With the inclusion of 99 Nights In The Forest into the cosmetics catalog, Fortnite has introduced another viral indie hit in the space of a week or so, after adding Five Nights at Freddy’s first earlier this month. It will be interesting to see if there are any more majorly popular independently developed titles making their way to Epic’s online multiplayer before the end of this season.

Regardless, Fortnite Override has shaped up to be a rather content-rich season in terms of licensed IP content. From fan-favorite skins of previous collabs such as the Resident Evil skins and Universal Monsters skins to highly anticipated skins from new partnerships with Kingdom Hearts, Persona, and more, there’s been a wide variety to choose from. This has reasonably ensured there’s something interesting at present for everyone who plays Fortnite, whether it be a longtime fan or a newcomer.

FAQs

Can I get The Deer from 99 Nights In The Forest as a free skin in Fortnite?

No, it is only available in the Item Shop, in exchange for 1,500 V-Bucks.

Are there any other Roblox game cosmetics available in Fortnite?

No, there isn’t any other Roblox title that has collaborated with Fortnite to bring crossover content before.

Which other video game franchises have rolled out in Fortnite in recent weeks?

Everything from AAA franchises such as Persona to indie titles such as Five Nights at Freddy’s has released cosmetics in Fortnite lately.

title.rendered: How to get the Hollow Knight sidekick in Fortnite

content.rendered:
The Knight, the protagonist of the highly rated 2017 game called Hollow Knight, has arrived in Fortnite as a sidekick. Along with it, a few additional cosmetics themed around the side-scrolling indie sensation have also joined the Item Shop.

Over the years, the Hollow Knight IP’s status has shot up exponentially. After the original game blew up, the sequel that followed in 2025 achieved record-breaking success as well. Thanks to such strong appeal, it has now become the latest third-party collaborator in Fortnite.

The Hollow Knight promo is scheduled to run in the Shop until October 14, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET, so make sure to follow the steps given below before that window closes.

Steps to claim the Hollow Knight sidekick in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down to the “Hollow Knight” section and select the sidekick item.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to complete the process.

The Knight sidekick is also available as part of the Hollow Knight Bundle, which includes all the items inspired by the metroidvania hit. This package deal comes in at the discounted price of 2,000 V-Bucks (700 V-Bucks cheaper than otherwise).

All Hollow Knight cosmetics in Fortnite

1. The Knight

Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
Also available in: Hollow Knight Bundle

2. The Knight’s Nail pickaxe

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available in: Hollow Knight Bundle

3. Hallownest Grub back bling

Price: 400 V-Bucks
Also available in: Hollow Knight Bundle

Although the Fortnite x Hollow Knight collab content is far from prolific, a section of fans would still appreciate this crossover, given the sheer popularity of the latter franchise. Notably, The Knight is also the sixth video game character to land as a sidekick during Chapter 7 Season 4.

Wrapping up

The Fortnite Override season is turning out to be a blessing for video game enthusiasts, as it continues to bring together some of the biggest game franchises to Epic’s online multiplayer title. Not just indie darlings like Hollow Knight, but AAA heavyweights such as Persona 5 and Kingdom Hearts have also appeared in the game thus far, courtesy of the ongoing season’s core theme.

Over the course of the month, it will be exciting to see which other video game collab items Fortnite brings as Chapter 7 Season 4 comes to an end. Based on the fact that Fortnitemares, the game’s Halloween-themed event, will essentially cover the remainder of the season, it seems fair to assume any future crossover content is going to feature horror game IPs.

FAQs

Is the Hollow Knight sidekick free in Fortnite?

No, the sidekick known as “The Knight” is only available for purchase, and its price is 1,500 V-Bucks.

Is Hornet also available in Fortnite?

Even though Hornet, the protagonist of the sequel Hollow Knight: Silksong, is really popular, Fortnite doesn’t have it as an in-game cosmetic yet, and there are apparently no solid plans to change that in the future either.

Which sidekicks emerging from major IP collabs have rolled out so far in Fortnite Override?

Some of the most famous collab-powered additions to the sidekicks catalog during Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 are Tails (Sonic the Hedgehog), Spyro the Dragon, Rush from Mega Man, Pac-Man, and Morgana from Persona.

  • How to get Calm Capy sidekick in Fortnite
  • Flusher in Fortnite: What it is and where to find it
