title.rendered: The Company codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest The Company Codes on October 12, 2026

It’s time to experience corporate life with The Company on Roblox! This unique game combines roleplay with business management, allowing you to go up the corporate ladder by attending meetings, submitting proposals, earning promotions, and engaging in office politics. However, you’ll need plenty of cash to make progress and get the most out of your journey. To help you out, we’ve compiled a list of the latest active The Company codes that can reward you with tons of free cash!

All working The Company codes

  • GONE: Get 2500 Cash (NEW)
  • fall2026: 200 Rolls (NEW)
  • THEBESTGAMEEVER: Get 2500 Cash
  • BIGUPDATESOON: 2500 Cash

As of now, these are the only active The Company codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired or unverified The Company codes

ILOVETHECOMPANY, WELCOME2026

How to redeem The Company codes

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem The Company codes:

  1. Fire up The Company on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the Computer icon on the left side of the menu.
  4. Paste a working code in the URL tab and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more The Company codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for The Company codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official The Company Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Alliance Tower Defense Codes, Prehistoric Farm codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

title.rendered: Apple Watch Double Tap gesture not working? 9 Ways to fix it!

content.rendered:
Apple Watch Double Tap is one of those features I appreciate most when I want to answer a call, dismiss a notification, pause music, or scroll through Smart Stack without touching the display. But when the gesture stops responding, even simple actions can become frustrating.

The good news is that you don’t necessarily have a hardware problem. In most cases, checking a few settings and correcting how you perform the gesture can help. In this guide, I’ll explain why Double Tap might not be working on your Apple Watch in watchOS 27 and walk you through 9 fixes, including what to try on newer Apple Watch models.

Why isn’t Double Tap working on your Apple Watch?

Before changing settings, it’s worth understanding why the gesture might not respond.

Apple Watch uses motion and other sensor data to recognize Double Tap. The gesture is designed to work when you wear your watch correctly and perform the movement while the display is active.

Here are some common reasons it might fail:

  • Incompatible Apple Watch: Your model doesn’t support Double Tap.
  • Incorrect gesture: You aren’t bringing your thumb and index finger together twice at the right pace.
  • Low Power Mode: This mode disables Double Tap.
  • Sleep Focus: Double Tap isn’t available while Sleep Focus is active.
  • Locked or inactive display: The watch isn’t ready to recognize the gesture.
  • Accessibility conflicts: Certain accessibility features that use hand gestures prevent Double Tap from being enabled.
  • Unsupported screen or app: Double Tap doesn’t work everywhere.
  • Software glitches: A temporary watchOS issue might interfere with gesture recognition.
  • Wrist Detection or fit problems: The watch may not be detecting that you’re wearing it correctly.
  • Family Setup: Double Tap isn’t supported when the watch is configured for a family member through Apple Watch for your kids.

9 Ways to fix Apple Watch Double Tap gesture not working

Now that you’re well aware of the underlying reasons for the issue, let’s explore the solutions to get the Double Tap feature back on your Apple Watch.

1. Check if your Watch is compatible

First, confirm that your Apple Watch supports the feature. Installing watchOS 27 on a compatible watch doesn’t mean every watch model supports Double Tap.

Apple supports the Double Tap gesture on these models:

  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch SE 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4

Apple Watch Series 8 and earlier, the original Apple Watch SE, and Apple Watch Ultra (first generation) don’t support the built-in Double Tap gesture.

To check your model:

  1. Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
  2. Go to My Watch and tap General.
  3. Tap About.
  4. Check your Apple Watch model information.

If your watch is compatible, move on to the next fix.

2. Enable Double Tap and tap gestures

Sometimes, the gesture has been disabled accidentally, or its settings need attention after a software update.

Here’s how to check:

  1. Open Settings on your Apple Watch.
  2. Tap Gestures.
  3. Check that Gestures is enabled, if this option appears.
  4. Open Tap Gestures and make sure it is enabled.
  5. Return to the Gestures settings and select Double Tap, if available, to review its configuration.

You can also manage the available Double Tap settings through the Watch app on your iPhone.

If the feature was already enabled, turn it off, wait a moment, and turn it back on. Then test the gesture again.

3. Perform the Double Tap gesture correctly

The gesture might seem straightforward, but the timing and position of your fingers matter.

To perform Double Tap correctly:

  1. Wear your Apple Watch snugly on your wrist.
  2. Ensure that your Apple Watch is unlocked.
  3. Raise your wrist to wake the display. If it’s not enabled, go to Display & Brightness in Settings and toggle on Wake on Wrist Raise.

  4. Keep your hand relatively still.
  5. Bring your thumb and index finger together twice in quick succession.
  6. Perform the two taps at roughly the pace of double-clicking a computer mouse.

Avoid exaggerated hand movements. The goal is to make two distinct, quick taps rather than repeatedly touching your fingers together slowly.

Remember: Double Tap and the single-tap gesture introduced in watchOS 27 are different. A single tap selects a widget or supported control in Smart Stack, while Double Tap performs actions such as scrolling through Smart Stack or answering a call.

4. Turn off Low Power Mode, Sleep Focus, and other restricted modes

This is one of the first things I’d check because Double Tap isn’t available in certain system states.

Double Tap doesn’t work when Low Power Mode is enabled or Sleep Focus is active. It also won’t respond when the display is inactive because your wrist is down, or when the watch is locked.

Here’s what to do:

  1. Open Control Center on your Apple Watch.
  2. Check whether Low Power Mode is enabled and turn it off.

  3. Check whether Sleep Focus is active and disable it.
  4. Make sure the watch is unlocked.
  5. Raise your wrist to wake the display.
  6. Try the gesture again.

Theater Mode and Water Lock are also worth checking if your display isn’t waking as expected. Turn off any relevant mode and test again.

5. Check Wrist Detection and watch fit

Wrist Detection helps your Apple Watch determine whether you’re wearing it. If it is disabled or the watch doesn’t fit correctly, you may encounter problems with certain features.

To check Wrist Detection:

  1. Open Settings on your Apple Watch.
  2. Tap Passcode.
  3. Make sure Wrist Detection is enabled.
  4. Return to Settings and open Display & Brightness.
  5. Check the available Wrist Detection-related settings if shown.
  6. Make sure your watch fits snugly without being uncomfortably tight.

Also, verify that your Apple Watch is configured for the wrist on which you wear it. Open Settings → General → Orientation and check the wrist selection.

If you recently changed wrists, correct the setting and try Double Tap again.

6. Check Accessibility settings

Certain accessibility features use hand gestures in ways that conflict with Double Tap.

According to Apple, you can’t enable tap gestures when features such as these are active:

  • AssistiveTouch
  • Quick Actions
  • Zoom with Hand Gestures
  • VoiceOver with Hand Gestures

If you use any of these features, review their settings before troubleshooting further.

Open Settings → Accessibility on your Apple Watch and check the relevant options. If you’re comfortable doing so, temporarily disable the conflicting gesture feature and test Double Tap again.

7. Check whether the current app supports Double Tap

Double Tap doesn’t work in every Apple Watch app or on every screen.

Apple provides built-in actions for supported experiences, including:

  • Answering or ending a phone call
  • Replying to a message
  • Playing or pausing supported media
  • Stopping a timer
  • Snoozing an alarm
  • Opening and scrolling through Smart Stack
  • Scrolling through supported apps
  • Taking a photo through Camera Remote
  • Pausing and resuming a stopwatch
  • Recording a voice memo
  • Switching flashlight modes

However, Double Tap isn’t available while using the Depth app or taking an ECG. Third-party apps also need to support the gesture appropriately.

If the Double Tap indicator shakes from side to side, that indicates the gesture isn’t available on the current screen or in that app.

Try testing it on the watch face or in a supported app before assuming the feature is broken.

8. Restart your Apple Watch

If the settings look correct but Double Tap remains unresponsive, restart your Apple Watch.

A restart can resolve temporary software glitches without erasing your data.

  1. Take your Apple Watch off its charger.
  2. Press and hold the side button to access the power controls.
  3. Tap the Power button and drag the Power Off slider.
  4. Wait a few seconds.
  5. Turn it back on by pressing and holding the side button.
  6. Once the watch starts, unlock it and test Double Tap again.

If your watch is frozen and you can’t restart it normally, you can consider a force restart. However, don’t force-restart your watch while a software update is in progress.

In some cases, unpairing and re-pairing the devices may be necessary for a complete reset of all settings.

10. Update to the latest watchOS version

If none of the previous fixes work, check for a software update. Apple periodically releases updates that improve system reliability and address bugs.

To update directly on your Apple Watch:

  1. Connect your Apple Watch to Wi-Fi.
  2. Place it on its charger.
  3. Make sure the battery is sufficiently charged.
  4. Open Settings.
  5. Tap General → Software Update.
  6. Install an available update if one is offered.

Alternatively, open the Watch app on your iPhone and go to General → Software Update.

Keep your paired iPhone updated as well if an associated update is required. After installation, test Double Tap on the watch face and in a supported app.

When should you contact Apple Support?

If you’ve checked compatibility, enabled the gestures, disabled restricted modes, reviewed accessibility settings, restarted your watch, and installed available updates, the problem may require further investigation.

Contact Apple Support if:

  • Neither single-tap nor Double Tap works in supported situations.
  • Your Apple Watch has suffered a drop or physical damage.
  • Other sensor-related features are also behaving unusually.
  • The gesture continues to fail after software troubleshooting.

Apple can help determine whether the problem is software-related or whether your watch needs inspection.

You can start through the Apple Support website or the Apple Support app on your iPhone.

Get Double Tap working again!

Apple Watch Double Tap is useful for handling everyday tasks without reaching for the display, but it depends on compatible hardware, the right settings, and supported screens.

When the gesture stops working, I recommend checking Low Power Mode, Sleep Focus, Wrist Detection, and the way you’re performing the gesture before trying more drastic fixes.

If you’ve recently upgraded to watchOS 27, remember that Single Tap and Double Tap are separate features. Once you understand when to use each gesture, navigating Smart Stack and performing supported actions becomes much easier.

Have you experienced Double Tap problems on your Apple Watch after updating to watchOS 27? Let us know which fix worked for you in the comments.

FAQs

Why does my Apple Watch Double Tap icon shake?

A shaking Double Tap indicator means the gesture isn’t available on that particular screen or in the current third-party app. Try it on the watch face or in another supported app.

Can tattoos stop Double Tap from working?

Apple notes that tattoos on the wrist can interfere with tap gesture recognition. Try wearing the watch on your other wrist to see whether the gesture works more reliably.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Apple Watch Double Tap icon shake?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shaking Double Tap indicator means the gesture isn't available on that particular screen or in the current third-party app. Try it on the watch face or in another supported app.

mainEntity.name: Can tattoos stop Double Tap from working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple notes that tattoos on the wrist can interfere with tap gesture recognition. Try wearing the watch on your other wrist to see whether the gesture works more reliably.

title.rendered: Smart Stack on Apple Watch: Your wrist’s smartest upgrade yet

content.rendered:
I used to think of Smart Stack as a convenient place to check the weather, upcoming appointments, and activity progress without opening individual apps. But Apple has made it much more useful in watchOS 27 by improving contextual suggestions and introducing a new single-tap gesture that lets you interact with widgets using one hand.

Smart Stack is one of those Apple Watch features that becomes more useful once you customize it around your daily routine. In this guide, I’ll explain how Smart Stack works in watchOS 27, what’s new, how to add and pin widgets, and solutions to common issues.

What is Smart Stack on Apple Watch?

Smart Stack is a dynamic collection of widgets that you can access directly from your Apple Watch face. It surfaces contextual and relevant information from your apps, such as weather forecasts, calendar appointments, activity progress, timers, and Live Activities.

Unlike complications, which occupy specific areas of a watch face, Smart Stack lets you access multiple widgets without changing your watch face.

Smart Stack also uses information such as your location, time of day, and recent activity to suggest relevant widgets. When it has an immediately useful suggestion, your Apple Watch can gently tap your wrist and display a hint at the bottom of the watch face.

For example, you might see a workout suggestion around your usual exercise time or a reminder related to an upcoming event.

Why should you use Smart Stack?

Smart Stack makes it easier to access important information without opening several apps or cluttering your watch face with complications.

Here are the main reasons I recommend using it:

  • Keep your watch face clean: You can maintain a minimalist watch face while keeping important information one gesture away.
  • Access information quickly: Check your calendar, weather, timers, and other widgets without searching through the app grid.
  • Get contextual suggestions: Smart Stack can surface widgets based on your routine, location, and recent activity.
  • View Live Activities: Follow supported real-time activities, such as workouts and timers, directly from your wrist.
  • Use one-handed controls: In watchOS 27, compatible Apple Watch models let you use a single-tap gesture to select a widget or interact with its controls.

How to access Smart Stack on Apple Watch

There are several ways to open Smart Stack, depending on your Apple Watch model and the gestures you have enabled.

Method 1: Use the Digital Crown

  1. Wake your Apple Watch and go to the watch face.
  2. Rotate the Digital Crown upward.
  3. Scroll through the available widgets.
  4. Tap a widget to open its associated app.

Method 2: Swipe Up

  1. Start from your watch face.
  2. Swipe up from the bottom of the screen.
  3. Scroll through Smart Stack to find the widget you need.
  4. Tap the widget to open it.

Method 3: Use Double Tap and Single Tap

On compatible Apple Watch models (Series 9, Ultra 2, SE 3 or later), you can use hand gestures to navigate Smart Stack.

  1. Raise your wrist and open Smart Stack with the Double Tap gesture.
  2. Double-tap to scroll through widgets.
  3. Perform a single-tap gesture by bringing your index finger and thumb together once to select a widget.
  4. Use the same single-tap gesture to select supported controls inside the widget.

The new single-tap gesture in watchOS 27 is especially useful when your other hand is occupied. Gesture availability depends on your Apple Watch model and settings.

What’s new in Smart Stack in watchOS 27?

Apple hasn’t redesigned Smart Stack from scratch in watchOS 27. Instead, it has made the feature more proactive and easier to use.

1. New contextual widget suggestions

Smart Stack can now surface additional suggestions when they become relevant to your routine or circumstances.

Examples include:

  • Parked Car: Quickly access information about where you parked your car.
  • Birthday reminders: Get a timely reminder to wish a close contact a happy birthday.
  • Transit-card balance: See relevant balance changes for a supported transit card.
  • Noise alerts: Get a Noise app widget suggestion after receiving a loud-noise notification.

These suggestions appear when Apple Watch determines that the information may be useful. You don’t necessarily need to pin every widget manually.

2. A new single-tap gesture

watchOS 27 introduces a single-tap gesture to select Smart Stack widgets and interact with supported widget controls without using the Digital Crown or touching the display.

For instance, it helped me quickly select a widget or interact with a supported music playback control.

Remember that single tap and Double Tap serve different purposes. Double-tap can open and scroll through Smart Stack on supported models, while a single tap selects a widget or control.

3. Smarter suggestions based on your routine

Smart Stack continues to learn from your daily routine and uses on-device data and trends to determine when a suggestion might be helpful.

For example, it might suggest a workout around a time when you regularly exercise or surface relevant information based on your recent activity.

These suggestions may take time to become useful because Apple Watch needs to learn your routine. You shouldn’t expect every contextual suggestion to appear immediately after updating to watchOS 27.

4. Live Activities remain part of Smart Stack

Live Activities provide real-time information from supported apps. Depending on the app, you can use them to follow a running workout, monitor a timer, or check the progress of another ongoing activity.

They update as the activity progresses, allowing you to see relevant information without repeatedly opening the associated app.

How to customize Smart Stack on Apple Watch

You can add, remove, rearrange, and pin widgets directly on your Apple Watch. I recommend pinning the widgets you use regularly and allowing Smart Stack to suggest other information when it becomes relevant.

Customize using your watch

  1. Access the Smart Stack and scroll all the way to the bottom.
  2. Tap the Edit button.
  3. To add a widget, tap the Add Widget (+) button and select the widget you want.


  4. To remove a widget, tap its Remove (–) button.
  5. Tap the Pin icon to keep your most important widgets at the top so they won’t move around as Smart Stack changes its suggestions.
  6. You can also touch and hold a pinned widget and drag it to change its position among your pinned widgets.


  7. Tap Done when you’ve finished making changes.
  8. Scroll to the bottom and tap Widget Suggestions.
  9. Turn Allow Widget Suggestions off or keep it on, based on your preference.

Some apps provide multiple widgets or additional customization options, so check the available choices before adding one.

Customize via iPhone:

The Watch app on your iPhone allows you to decide which apps can automatically or never display widgets in the Smart Stack.

  1. Open the Watch app and ensure you are on the My Watch tab.
  2. Tap on Smart Stack.
  3. From here, you can:
    • Toggle on Live Activities to have it appear in the Smart Stack.
    • Toggle on Auto-Launch Live Activities if you want Live Activities to appear in the Smart Stack as soon as they begin on the paired iPhone.
    • Enable or disable app widgets and control which apps can surface widgets automatically.

If your Apple Watch keeps showing an ongoing activity when you’d rather see your widgets, review these settings before removing useful widgets from the stack.

Best widgets to use in Smart Stack

Although Smart Stack automatically adjusts based on context, here are some top widgets to consider pinning:

  • Workout: Quickly start and track your workouts, whether you’re at the gym, on the run, or hiking in nature.
  • Now Playing/Music: Control playback and browse your favorite tunes. See album art and skip tracks without reaching for your phone.
  • Calendar: Stay on top of your daily schedule.
  • Weather: Check current conditions and forecasts instantly.
  • Heart Rate: Monitor heart health throughout the day.
  • Timer: Perfect for quick tasks like cooking or focus sessions. Set and monitor timers directly from your wrist.
  • Activity Rings: Track your Move, Exercise, and Stand goals — all without leaving the Smart Stack.
  • World Clock: Quickly view the time in various cities, ideal for traveling or working across multiple time zones.
  • Compass: Easily check your bearing and elevation when you’re out hiking or exploring.
  • Wallet: Keep a compatible pass or card accessible when needed.

Smart Stack tips and tricks for maximum efficiency

Maximize your Smart Stack experience with these expert tips:

  • Customize Your Stack: Add the widgets you use most and remove the ones you use least.
  • Prioritize Time-Sensitive Info: Pin widgets from apps like Calendar, Timer, or Weather at the top so you see them first when they matter most.
  • Keep It Minimal: Smart Stack is designed to help you access relevant information faster; therefore, I recommend adding or pinning a small group of essential widgets.
  • Leverage Contextual Hints: Pay attention to the hints that appear. Smart Stack will proactively suggest widgets based on location, time of day, or even workout habits.
  • Take advantage of Live Activities: Live Activities display real-time information, such as ongoing workouts, countdowns, or ride-share ETAs. They update dynamically, so you don’t have to keep checking separate apps. You can control which apps can surface Live Activities and which cannot.

Common Smart Stack problems and fixes

While Apple designed the Smart Stack to work seamlessly, like any other technology feature, it can occasionally encounter issues. Here are some common problems users face and how to fix them:

The smart way to use your Apple Watch

Smart Stack is more useful when you treat it as a personalized information hub rather than just another place to store widgets. With watchOS 27, contextual suggestions make it easier to find relevant information, while the new single-tap gesture offers another way to interact with widgets when your hands are occupied.

My recommendation is to pin the information you check every day, keep unnecessary widgets out of the stack, and give Smart Stack time to learn your routine. That way, your Apple Watch face stays clean without sacrificing quick access to useful information.

FAQs

Can I disable Smart Stack on my Apple Watch?

Smart Stack is a built-in watchOS feature. Rather than disabling the entire feature, you can remove unwanted widgets, pin the ones you need, and adjust the available suggestion settings.

How many widgets can I add to Smart Stack?

Apple doesn’t specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

Can I use third-party widgets in Smart Stack?

Yes. Compatible third-party apps can provide widgets for Smart Stack. The available widgets depend on the app and its support for your watchOS version.

What is the difference between Smart Stack and complications?

Complications display selected information directly on your watch face. Smart Stack is a separate collection of widgets that you can open to access more information without changing your watch face.

mainEntity.name: Why does my Apple Watch Double Tap icon shake?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shaking Double Tap indicator means the gesture isn't available on that particular screen or in the current third-party app. Try it on the watch face or in another supported app.

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple notes that tattoos on the wrist can interfere with tap gesture recognition. Try wearing the watch on your other wrist to see whether the gesture works more reliably.

mainEntity.name: Can I disable Smart Stack on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart Stack is a built-in watchOS feature. Rather than disabling the entire feature, you can remove unwanted widgets, pin the ones you need, and adjust the available suggestion settings.

mainEntity.name: How many widgets can I add to Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple doesn't specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

mainEntity.name: Can I use third-party widgets in Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Compatible third-party apps can provide widgets for Smart Stack. The available widgets depend on the app and its support for your watchOS version.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Smart Stack and complications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Complications display selected information directly on your watch face. Smart Stack is a separate collection of widgets that you can open to access more information without changing your watch face.

title.rendered: How to use Adaptive Audio and Personalized Volume on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods 5

content.rendered:
AirPods Pro 3 and both AirPods 5 models support Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, and Conversation Awareness. They adjust noise control and volume as your surroundings change, so you spend less time reaching for the controls.

Here’s how to turn them on. The same steps also work on AirPods Pro 2, AirPods 4 with ANC, and AirPods Max 2.

How does Adaptive Audio work on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods 5?

If you’re a fan of the ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) and Transparency modes on your AirPods, you have to manually switch between them by pressing the AirPods’ stems. Adaptive Audio lets your AirPods adjust noise control as your surroundings change.

Adaptive Audio blends Active Noise Cancellation and Transparency based on your surroundings. It can let more of the world in when you need to hear it, without requiring you to switch modes manually.

You can switch to Adaptive mode by following these simple steps:

  1. Connect your AirPods to your iPhone if you haven’t.
  2. Open the Control Center on your iPhone by swiping down from the battery icon at the top.
  3. Long-press the volume slider until noise control options appear.
  4. Tap Listening Mode, then choose Adaptive.

Once enabled, your AirPods adjust the blend of noise cancellation and Transparency based on your surroundings.

Personalized Volume

Personalized Volume uses on-device machine learning to understand your environment and volume preferences over time. It then adjusts the media volume to suit your surroundings and how you like to listen.

To turn it on:

  1. Connect your AirPods to your iPhone.
  2. Open Settings and select your AirPods near the top.
  3. Open Audio & Routing if needed, then turn on Personalized Volume.

Use Conversation Awareness

Removing your AirPods every time you want to talk to someone can be annoying. Conversation Awareness lets you leave them in for a quick chat.

Conversation Awareness automatically lowers the media volume on your AirPods once you start talking. Furthermore, it’ll enhance the audio of the person in front of you while reducing background noise.

To turn on Conversation Awareness:

  1. Wear your AirPods and connect them to your iPhone.
  2. Open Control Center and touch and hold the volume slider.
  3. Tap Conversation Awareness.

AirPods Automatic Switching feature

One of the most important features of the Apple ecosystem is switching your AirPods between devices. However, it hasn’t been reliable many times; for instance, if you connect your AirPods to your Mac and start listening on your iPhone, your AirPods will switch to the iPhone, but the vice versa isn’t always the case.

Automatic Switching works between compatible Apple devices signed in to the same Apple Account. So if you’re playing media on an iPhone with AirPods, and then you start playing media on your Mac, your AirPods will switch to the Mac instantly.

Don’t worry; you’ll have the undo option to go back to the previous device if you don’t want your AirPods to switch.

Wrapping up…

These features let you adjust noise control, personalize volume, and hear conversations without removing your earbuds. Which one do you use most?

Read more:

  • How to change notification volume on AirPods
  • How to setup Personalized Spatial Audio for AirPods

mainEntity.name: Can I disable Smart Stack on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart Stack is a built-in watchOS feature. Rather than disabling the entire feature, you can remove unwanted widgets, pin the ones you need, and adjust the available suggestion settings.

mainEntity.name: How many widgets can I add to Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple doesn't specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

mainEntity.name: Can I use third-party widgets in Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Compatible third-party apps can provide widgets for Smart Stack. The available widgets depend on the app and its support for your watchOS version.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Smart Stack and complications?

acceptedAnswer.text: Complications display selected information directly on your watch face. Smart Stack is a separate collection of widgets that you can open to access more information without changing your watch face.

title.rendered: iPhone Photographic Styles: How to use and customize them

content.rendered:
Apple introduced Photographic Styles to give users more control over how their iPhone processes photos. Instead of applying filters after capturing an image, Photographic Styles adjust tone and color preferences directly within the camera’s processing pipeline. You can also edit photos later in the Photos app to fine-tune lighting, colors, and other details after capturing the shot. The feature debuted with the iPhone 13 lineup; newer models have added more customization and editing controls.

Keep reading to learn how to use Photographic Styles on your iPhone, customize them, and edit them after capturing photos.

What are the Photographic Styles on iPhone?

Photographic Styles on the iPhone allow you to personalize the tone and color of your photos without losing natural elements like skin tones. They essentially offer you a way to create a consistent aesthetic, much like professional photographers do with their editing workflows.

Think of Photographic Styles as a more flexible alternative to filters. Filters apply a fixed look to a photo, but with Photographic Styles, you can adjust parameters like warmth and contrast, which gives you far more control over your photos. As a result, unlike traditional filters, which can sometimes look artificial, Photographic Styles are designed to blend seamlessly with your original image, enhancing its natural beauty.

Which iPhones Support Photographic Styles?

Photographic Styles are available on modern iPhones that use Apple’s advanced computational photography system.

Supported devices include:

  • iPhone SE (3rd Gen)
  • iPhone 13, 13 mini, 13 Pro, and 13 Pro Max
  • iPhone 14 series
  • iPhone 15 series
  • iPhone 16 series and iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 17 series and iPhone 17e
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max

Photographic Styles 3 is available on iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. It adds texture presets and a Grain control.

Types of Photographic Styles Available

With the iPhone, Apple offers a variety of Photographic Styles designed to fit different moods, aesthetics, and photography types. Let’s check them out.

  • Bright: Increases overall exposure and highlights to make photos look lighter and more vibrant, which works well for well-lit scenes and daylight shots.
  • Cool Rose: Adds a subtle, cool tint with a slight rose hue, perfect for making cooler landscapes or portraits feel dreamy without looking cold.
  • Neutral: A balanced, natural look that enhances the photo’s original colors without making them too bright or too dark.
  • Rose Gold: Infuses a soft, warm glow into your shots, ideal for adding a touch of romance or nostalgia to your photos.
  • Gold: Warmer than Rose Gold, this style gives your images a more luxurious golden glow, which is perfect for portraits and nature shots during the golden hour.
  • Amber: It deepens the warmth, making sunsets, cozy indoor scenes, and even food photos more inviting and vivid.
  • Standard (No Edits): This is the baseline option where no tweaks are applied. It preserves the original colors and lighting and is perfect for those who want the camera’s default look.
  • Vibrant: Adds extra saturation and punch to your colors without overwhelming the image, and is great for bringing out the vibrancy of nature and cityscapes.
  • Natural: Keeps the photo looking as close to the real scene as possible, which makes it perfect for those who like unedited, raw photos.
  • Luminous: A dreamy, ethereal style that brightens the image, giving a soft, glowing look. It’s excellent for portraits or scenes where you want a magical feel.
  • Dramatic: Heightens contrast, darkens shadows, and pulls out details to add a cinematic touch to your images, perfect for urban photography or landscapes with strong textures.
  • Quiet: Subdued and gentle, this style tones down colors, creating a peaceful and introspective feel. It’s ideal for soft lighting or minimalist photography.
  • Cozy: Infuses warmth and comfort into your shots, making them feel more intimate. Think of it as a way to bring out the feeling of home in your images.
  • Ethereal: A light, airy style that softens shadows and cools down colors, ideal for portraits or landscapes with a delicate, fairy-tale-like atmosphere.
  • Muted Black and White: Softens contrasts while keeping things monochromatic, giving your black-and-white shots a more muted, relaxed feel.
  • Stark Black and White: This one is all about drama—deep shadows and bright highlights for high-impact black-and-white photography that demands attention.

How to Use Photographic Styles on iPhone

Now that you have a good idea of what Photographic Styles are, here’s how you can use them:

Apply a Photographic Style While Taking Photos

  1. Open the Camera app on your iPhone.
  2. Swipe up near the Capture button to bring up the camera toolbar.
  3. Tap Styles.
  4. Swipe through the available styles and select the style you want to use.
  5. Tap the Capture button to capture a photo using the chosen photographic style.

Customize Photographic Styles

You can fine-tune Photographic Styles using tone and warmth controls.

  1. In the Camera app, select the Photographic Style you want to use.
  2. Drag the slider to adjust the tone and color.

These adjustments let you personalize the style to your photography preferences. On iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, tap Texture to choose Soft Skin, Glow, or Film, and use Grain to add a film-like finish.

Set a Default Photographic Style

In addition to customizing a Photographic Style, you can also choose a style that the camera will use automatically.

  1. Go to Settings → Camera.
  2. Here, tap Photographic Styles under App Settings.
  3. Now, choose a style and tap the “Style” button to confirm.

Additionally, you can tap the Customize button to customize the chosen style.

Reset or Remove Photographic Styles

In case you don’t like Photographic Styles, you can easily reset it using the steps below:

  1. Navigate to Settings > Camera > Photographic Styles.
  2. Here, tap Reset to Standard. This will remove the current Photographic Style.
  3. Once done, you can then tap Get Started to choose a new Photographic Style as the default.

How to Edit Photographic Styles After Taking a Photo

If you are not happy with the Photographic Style applied to a photo, you can customize or change it after capturing the image on supported newer models. For the latest-generation styles, set Settings → Camera → Formats to High Efficiency before shooting. Here is how:

  1. In the Photos app, open the photo you want to edit.
  2. Tap the Edit button in the bottom center.
  3. Tap Styles, then swipe through the options and choose a different style.
  4. You can also adjust the Tone and Color by dragging the sliders into the Photographic Styles panel.
    You can also adjust the Tone and Color by dragging the sliders into the Photographic Styles panel.

When to Use Photographic Styles

Different scenes and subjects call for different photographic moods, and that’s where Photographic Styles really shine. Let’s break down when and where each style works best.

1. Portrait Photography

  • Rich Contrast: If you want a bold, dramatic portrait, it’s a great choice. It deepens shadows and increases contrast, which adds more definition and intensity to facial features.
  • Warm: Works well for soft, natural-looking portraits. It adds gentle golden tones that create a cozy and inviting feel, making it ideal for family photos or candid moments.

2. Landscape Photography

  • Vibrant: When capturing landscapes filled with colorful skies, flowers, or greenery, Vibrant enhances saturation, so the colors appear richer and more eye-catching while maintaining detail.
  • Cool: Works well in calm environments such as snowy landscapes, water scenes, or early-morning cityscapes. It reduces warm tones and introduces a subtle bluish hue, creating a more tranquil mood.

3. Street Photography

  • Standard: The image remains neutral and balanced. It is a good option for street photography where you want to capture scenes naturally without heavy stylistic changes.
  • Rich Contrast: Urban environments often contain strong light and shadow. Rich Contrast emphasizes these elements, adding depth and drama to street scenes.

4. Event Photography

  • Vibrant: For parties, festivals, and sports events, Vibrant boosts colors and energy in the frame, helping the scene feel livelier and more dynamic.

5. Food Photography

  • Warm: It enhances golden tones and highlights textures, making dishes appear more appetizing and visually appealing.

How Do Photographic Styles Differ From Traditional Filters?

Unlike traditional filters, Photographic Styles are designed to blend seamlessly with your original image, enhancing its natural beauty rather than drastically altering its appearance.

They are also more customizable, allowing you to adjust their intensity to your liking. And while Android phone cameras do have customizable filters where one can control the intensity, Apple’s implementation allows one to customize the Photographic Styles with multiple values, making it better suited for a variety of different skin colors.

Signing off…

Photographic Styles give iPhone users greater control over how their photos look right out of the camera. By adjusting tone and color preferences during image processing, the feature creates photos that match your personal style without relying on heavy editing later. Once you start experimenting with different styles and customization options, you can make your iPhone photos look more consistent and visually appealing.

Which Photographic Style works best for your photos? Tell us in the comments below.

FAQs

Can I apply Photographic Styles after taking a picture?

Yes, you can. You can edit your photos and apply Photographic Styles using the Photos app on your iPhone.

Do Photographic Styles affect video recording?

No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings.

title.rendered: How to use personalized spatial audio on your AirPods

content.rendered:
Personalized Spatial Audio is an Apple feature that customizes audio playback according to your ear and head shape profile. It creates a more immersive and theater-like listening experience, especially when watching movies and TV shows. Excited to try it out? Here’s how you can set up Personalized Spatial Audio for AirPods.

What is Personalized Spatial Audio?

According to Apple, “With Personalized Spatial Audio, the AirPods listening experience is even more immersive. Users perceive sound individually based on the size and shape of their heads and ears. Using the TrueDepth camera on iPhone, users can create a personal profile for Spatial Audio that delivers a listening experience precisely tuned just for them.”

Spatial Audio is Apple’s way of creating a precise 360° surround sound experience. In conjunction with customized Spatial Audio, everyone is assigned their personalized profile. This profile adjusts audio tuning to match how you hear sound.

With the help of the TrueDepth cameras, Apple has created technology that can give you an experience like no other brand. The best part is that your Spatial Audio profile syncs across your Apple devices signed in to the same Apple Account.

What devices support Apple Spatial Audio?

To create a Personalized Spatial Audio profile, you need an iPhone with a TrueDepth camera running iOS 16 or later. Here is a list of supported AirPods:

  • AirPods Pro (1st gen)
  • AirPods Pro (2nd gen) and AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods (3rd gen and later, including AirPods 5)
  • AirPods Max
  • Beats Fit Pro, Beats Solo 4, and Beats Studio Pro

After setup, your Personalized Spatial Audio profile syncs to compatible Apple devices signed in to the same Apple Account, including iPad with iPadOS 16.1 or later and Mac with macOS Ventura or later.

The initial face and ear scan needs an iPhone with a TrueDepth camera, so iPhone SE models cannot create the profile.

How to set up Personalized Spatial Audio for your AirPods

  1. Once your iPhone is updated to the latest iOS, open the AirPods case lid with AirPods inside and hold it close to your iPhone. Now, you will get a prompt asking you to try Personalized Spatial Audio.
  2. Tap Get Started → Continue.

If you don’t see the prompt, you can manually start the setup. To do so, connect your AirPods and wear it. Then, go to Settings on your iPhone and select the connected AirPods or Beats name at the top. Now, open Audio & Routing → Personalized Spatial Audio → Personalize Spatial Audio.

You can choose See & Hear How It Works to see how Spatial Audio differs from Stereo Audio. If you like the sound experience, you can continue the setup.

Now, take the AirPods out of your ear, as the iPhone Camera needs to scan your ear with an unobstructed view.

  1. Tap Start Front View Capture and follow the audio and visual cues.
  2. Place your iPhone right in front of you, about 12 inches away. To capture your face from every angle, place your face in the camera frame and then gently rotate your head in a circle. Press Continue once done.
  3. Proceed by tapping Start Right Ear Capture. Take your iPhone in your right hand and hold it to your right side at arm’s length. Now, slowly move your head to the left to capture your right ear.
  4. Once done, continue by selecting Start Left Ear Capture and follow the method on your left side.

Once the setup is done, you can enjoy the surreal immersive audio experience. However, note that you must disable certain settings, including Balance, Mono Audio, and Headphone Accommodations, to ensure the feature works best.

If the Personalized Spatial Audio setup is not working, reset your AirPods once and try these steps again.

How to turn on Personalized Spatial Audio on iPhone manually

  1. Launch a media app to begin streaming music, a movie, or a TV program with your AirPods connected.
  2. Scroll down from the right side to open the Control Center on your iPhone.
  3. Press and hold the volume tile.
  4. Now, tap Spatial Audio or Spatial Audio based on the audio you are listening to.
  5. Select Head Tracked to enable dynamic head tracking and spatial audio. This will tune your audio based on your head movements.

Your iPhone will remember your choice. For instance, you have followed the above steps while listening to the Music app. The next time you play a song in the app, the Head Tracked option is immediately enabled.

You will also see an option called Fixed in the Control Center. It makes the audio sound like you are in the middle of the environment. So, it has a smaller range of sound projection locations. To make the sound all around you, personalized spatial audio tracks your head or device movements.

By default, spatial audio follows your iPhone’s motion to make the music sound like it’s coming from your iPhone. To change this, go to Settings and select Accessibility. Then tap AirPods and toggle off Follow iPhone. The audio will now seem to follow your head movements.

Finishing off…

Apple is making great strides in providing its users with a personalized experience. Over the years, the company has made itself synonymous with spell-binding experiences, and personalized spatial audio is a valuable addition to them.

Read more:

  • How to check your AirPods’ battery level on any device
  • How to update your AirPods to the latest firmware version

title.rendered: Apple reportedly plans a major iPhone Duo store showcase, but supply may be tight

content.rendered:
Apple is preparing a larger-than-usual in-store display for the iPhone Duo, but the first wave of stock could still be limited, according to a Bloomberg report cited by MacRumors. The foldable phone is already official, with preorders opening October 16 and sales beginning October 23. Apple has not confirmed the reported store rollout or how many units will be available.

The reported display plan includes more demo phones at Apple’s busiest locations and a new fixture designed to show the device opening and closing. That could give shoppers a better way to try the iPhone Duo before buying it, but it may not solve the main concern for launch day: how quickly early inventory sells out.

Apple is preparing more hands-on demos

Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple is setting up more iPhone Duo demo units than it typically provides for a new model. The report says the Fifth Avenue store in New York will have more than 150 demos, while Apple Park’s visitor center will have nearly 100. Other stores are expected to get around 20, with several high-profile locations receiving 30 to 40.

The showcase is designed to make the foldable form factor easier to understand. The reported fixture lets customers open and close a demo unit, while a MagSafe stand can hold the iPhone Duo open beside two regular iPhones. That gives shoppers a direct comparison with the familiar iPhone shape and a chance to see how the larger inside screen works.

These details come from reporting, not an Apple retail announcement. The company has not published a store-by-store list of demo counts or said which locations will have the special fixture. The number of display phones also does not indicate how many units will be available for purchase.

Preorders open October 16, with launch stock reportedly limited

Apple has confirmed that the iPhone Duo goes on sale October 23 in more than 70 countries and regions. In the United States, it starts at $1,999 for 256GB. Preorders begin October 16 at 5 a.m. Pacific time.

In the U.S., Apple’s Store app is already showing a “Get Ready” step for buyers. People can select a configuration ahead of preorder day, which may make checkout quicker when orders open. It is a useful option for anyone set on buying at launch, especially if the reported supply constraint means popular colors or storage sizes sell through quickly.

Bloomberg says Apple expects limited availability at launch, although it has enough units for the October 23 release after earlier production concerns. The report says the company had worried that manufacturing constraints could push some sales into November. Apple has not shared a stock estimate, so it is not possible to know how long buyers may wait after launch.

The iPhone Duo’s price makes trying it in a store especially relevant. At $1,999, it costs substantially more than Apple’s conventional iPhones, and shoppers may want to test the hinge, folded size and inside display before deciding. The new display setup could make that easier at flagship stores, but most locations are reportedly getting fewer demo units.

Apple’s official iPhone Duo announcement has the confirmed price and release details. For more context, see our iPhone Duo guide and preorder checklist.

acceptedAnswer.text: A shaking Double Tap indicator means the gesture isn't available on that particular screen or in the current third-party app. Try it on the watch face or in another supported app.

mainEntity.name: Can I disable Smart Stack on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart Stack is a built-in watchOS feature. Rather than disabling the entire feature, you can remove unwanted widgets, pin the ones you need, and adjust the available suggestion settings.

mainEntity.name: How many widgets can I add to Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple doesn't specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

mainEntity.name: Can I use third-party widgets in Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Compatible third-party apps can provide widgets for Smart Stack. The available widgets depend on the app and its support for your watchOS version.

title.rendered: New Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini could ship on October 30

content.rendered:
Apple could start selling a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini on October 30, according to Bloomberg reporting cited by MacRumors. The date would put the two home devices less than three weeks after Apple’s October 13 “Welcome home” press event. Apple has not confirmed either product or the reported release date.

The timing points to a possible staggered update for Apple’s home lineup. The rumored Apple TV and speaker could arrive first, while a separate smart-home hub is reportedly planned for November. That would give Apple several weeks to introduce new devices, but it remains a report rather than an announced launch schedule.

Two long-running products may be due for updates

Apple last refreshed the Apple TV 4K in 2022, while the HomePod mini has been on sale since 2020. Both products still work with Apple’s current services, but an update could give the company a chance to improve how it handles Siri and smart-home controls.

The latest report is specific about the expected shipping date, not the hardware. It does not confirm the new Apple TV’s processor, price, storage, video capabilities or a redesigned Siri Remote. Previous reporting has discussed changes Apple has tested for Siri on the Apple TV, but testing does not mean a feature will ship. Apple has not announced what, if anything, will change.

Details about the next HomePod mini are also unsettled. A second-generation model has been rumored, but Apple has not confirmed its chip, sound changes, connectivity features or price. The current mini remains the only model available from Apple. Shoppers should not assume that any rumored internal upgrade will be part of a product arriving on October 30.

The announcement and release dates could be different

Apple’s “Welcome home” teaser has prompted speculation about new home hardware, but it does not identify the Apple TV or HomePod mini. The press experience is scheduled for October 13 in New York. Apple has not said that a live, public product presentation will take place, and it has not listed products for the event.

If the October 30 date is accurate, Apple could announce the products before they are available to buy. The same report places the rumored HomeView hub in a later November window, which would make the release of the home lineup a two-step rollout. That timeline could change, and it is not yet clear whether every device would be available in the same countries on its first day.

For people waiting to replace an Apple TV or HomePod mini, the date is a reason to watch this week’s news rather than a reason to plan a purchase around a confirmed launch. Apple could reveal the products, push them to a later date or say nothing about them on October 13. Until then, specifications, pricing and availability remain unknown.

We’ve covered Apple’s rumored October product waves and the rumored smart-home hub timeline. Neither report confirms Apple’s plans for the Apple TV or HomePod mini.

mainEntity.name: Can I get the Kado Thorne skin in Fortnite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not really. While a range of Kado Thorne cosmetics are up for grabs for those who complete certain quests, none of those items include the villain's original skin.

mainEntity.name: Will Kado Thorne skin return to Fortnite in the future?

acceptedAnswer.text: Highly unlikely because, since its introduction in Chapter 4 Season 4, this skin has never returned in Fortnite via the Item Shop or any other means. However, a variant of the same, the Elite Kado Thorne skin, did come out as part of a cup reward earlier this month (no longer claimable).

title.rendered: Apple’s rumored HomeView hub could arrive in November with an A18 chip

content.rendered:
Apple may use its “Welcome home” event to introduce a new smart-home hub, but the company has not named any products for its October 13 press experience. A report says the device, possibly called HomeView, could arrive in November with an A18 chip and two designs for different parts of the home.

Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, via 9to5Mac, says the tabletop version will combine a screen with a speaker base and come in four colors: space gray, silver, starlight and pink. A second version designed for wall mounting is reportedly in the works in space gray and silver. Apple has not confirmed the name, designs, colors or release schedule.

Two designs could bring a screen into more rooms

The tabletop hub is described as a display that sits above a speaker base. A wall-mounted version would use a squarer base, giving people a way to put the screen in a more fixed spot. The reported color range suggests Apple could offer the tabletop model as a more visible home accessory, while the wall version would have a quieter finish.

The A18 chip is another reported detail. It would give the hub a newer processor than the one used in many existing Apple home accessories, but no performance, memory or feature details have been confirmed. Reports also describe the device as a home control point built around Siri and a screen for quick information. Apple has not explained how the hub would handle requests, connect with existing accessories or differ from controlling a home through an iPhone, iPad or HomePod.

The device’s name is still uncertain. “HomeView” has surfaced through a trademark filing by a company reported to be linked to Apple, but that does not establish that Apple will use the name publicly. Until Apple makes an announcement, the name and the rumored hardware should be treated as provisional.

November timing would follow Apple’s home-device event

Apple has teased an October 13 press experience with the words “Welcome home.” The invitation has fueled expectations of new home products, but it does not identify a smart display or promise a public livestream. Reports place the hub’s release around mid-November, which would put its availability after the event rather than on announcement day.

That timing would also separate the hub from two other rumored home products. Bloomberg reporting points to a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini arriving on October 30, while the hub is said to follow later. None of these product dates is confirmed by Apple.

If the reports are accurate, HomeView would give Apple a screen-first way to check information and control smart-home accessories in a shared room. The practical value will depend on details Apple has not shared, including supported apps, how much can be done without Siri, and what privacy controls will be available. People considering a smart display should wait for those details instead of assuming that the leaked designs describe a finished product.

For now, Apple’s teaser is the only confirmed part of the story. The company has not announced HomeView, a new Apple home hub, its colors or a November launch. We’ve covered Apple’s reported smart-home hub timeline and the rumored screen and design. You can also read about Apple’s earlier home-hub plans.

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple doesn't specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

title.rendered: OLED iPad mini could cost close to $800 as Apple prepares a major upgrade

content.rendered:
Apple’s next iPad mini could make the small tablet a much more expensive buy. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that the upcoming model will cost “considerably more” than the current version, with its price potentially landing closer to $799. Apple has not announced the tablet or confirmed its price.

That would be a steep jump from today’s iPad mini, which starts at $599. The rumored upgrade could bring an OLED screen, slimmer bezels and an improved speaker system, giving Apple a stronger reason to reposition its smallest tablet as a premium option.

The OLED upgrade could change where the mini sits

The current iPad mini has an 8.3-inch LCD display. Moving to OLED would be a meaningful change for a tablet built around portability: OLED screens can show deeper blacks and higher contrast than LCD panels. Apple has not confirmed the panel, its brightness, or whether the new model would include a faster refresh rate, so those details remain open.

The screen is not the only reported change. Gurman says Apple is also planning a redesigned speaker system and thinner bezels. Those updates would give the mini a more modern front and potentially improve its sound, but the report does not provide a final specification list. The current model remains the only one Apple sells.

An iPad mini at roughly $799 would also sit above the 11-inch iPad Air, which currently starts at $749 in the United States. That comparison could make buyers think twice: the Air gives them a larger screen for less, while the mini’s appeal is its compact size and one-handed portability. If Apple prices the new model near $799, it will need to make the display and other changes feel worthwhile to people who specifically want a small tablet.

The company already raised the current mini’s starting price to $599 earlier this year. A second increase would widen the gap between the mini and entry-level tablets, and could push some shoppers toward the Air or an older iPad mini while it is still available. The rumored price is not final, though, and Apple has not said whether it plans to keep selling the current model alongside the new one.

A late-October arrival is still only a report

Bloomberg has also pointed to a late-October arrival for the next iPad mini. Apple has a “Welcome home” press experience scheduled for October 13, but its public teaser does not name any products. The mini could be part of a later launch wave rather than the focus of that event.

For now, shoppers should treat both the OLED screen and the higher price as reported plans. Apple has not confirmed a product name, launch date, storage options, or whether the reported speaker and bezel changes will make it into the final device. People who need a tablet today can compare the current mini with the Air; anyone set on a new compact iPad may want to wait for Apple to announce its plans.

The possible redesign builds on earlier reporting about a more capable, water-resistant iPad mini, though those details have not been confirmed either. Apple’s October product lineup may also arrive in stages, with different devices appearing on separate dates.

Read more about the reported iPad mini redesign, Apple’s expected October product waves, and the recent price increases across Apple products.

acceptedAnswer.text: Smart Stack is a built-in watchOS feature. Rather than disabling the entire feature, you can remove unwanted widgets, pin the ones you need, and adjust the available suggestion settings.

mainEntity.name: How many widgets can I add to Smart Stack?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple doesn't specify a universal maximum number of widgets in its user guide. The available selection depends on compatible apps and widgets. Add the ones you find useful rather than following an arbitrary widget limit.

title.rendered: How to use Transparency mode on AirPods Pro and AirPods Max

content.rendered:
There are hundreds of TWS earbuds out there on the market, but what makes AirPods Pro and AirPods Max stand out from the crowd the most is Active Noise Cancellation. With the snug-fit profile, AirPods provide an excellent shield from outside noise, and you can continue listening to your favorite tracks or indulge in hands-free calling.

In addition, Apple has implemented a super useful feature called Transparency mode. As the name suggests, it allows some external noises to pass through. It helps you pay attention while using your AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, or AirPods 5 and listening to the music you love.

While it was already there, making life super convenient, Apple introduced yet another trailblazing feature to take AirPods Pro 2 to the next level. This feature is named Adaptive Transparency mode. Read on to learn more about Transparency and Adaptive Transparency modes.

How does Transparency mode work on AirPods Pro and Max?

Transparency mode uses the AirPods’ microphones and audio processing to let surrounding sounds through while you listen. The stem control switches modes on AirPods Pro and AirPods 5; it does not create the effect itself.

How to turn on or off Transparency mode

You can switch to Transparency mode from your AirPods Pro, AirPods 5, or AirPods Max or use the connected iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or Mac. A chime will confirm that Transparency mode is enabled or disabled on your AirPods.

  • On your AirPods Pro or AirPods 5: Press and hold the stem until you hear a chime.
  • On your AirPods Max: Press the noise control button.

How to use Transparency mode on iPhone and iPad

You can also switch between listening modes from Control Center on a compatible iPhone or iPad while your AirPods are connected.

  1. Open Control Center.
  2. Touch and hold the volume slider.
  3. Tap Listening Mode and choose Transparency.

You can also open Settings, tap your connected AirPods near the top, and choose Transparency under Listening Mode.

Also check out: How to change AirPods settings on iPhone or iPad

What is Adaptive Transparency on AirPods Pro 2

AirPods Pro 2 introduced Adaptive Transparency, which reduces the intensity of loud environmental sounds while leaving other sounds audible.

Its H2 chip adjusts Transparency when sudden loud sounds occur, such as traffic noise. Keep using appropriate hearing protection in very loud places.

Adaptive Transparency is separate from Adaptive Audio, which blends noise cancellation and Transparency as your surroundings change. AirPods 5 supports Adaptive Audio.

Fine-tune ANC and Transparency mode from iPhone

It’s worth reiterating that you will be able to access the options as mentioned above from the Settings app as well.

  1. Connect your AirPods and open Settings.
  2. Tap your AirPods name near the top.
  3. Choose a mode under Listening Mode.
  4. To change what a stem press does, open Controls & Gestures → Press and Hold.

Tip: There is a slightly hidden setting through which you can use noise cancellation when using only one AirPods Pro. Besides, you also have the option to fine-tune the press speed and hold duration required to activate the Force Sensors. To get it done, launch Settings → Accessibility → AirPods. Now, turn on the switch next to Noise Cancellation with One AirPod.

How to control ANC and Transparency mode settings from Apple Watch

You can also take control of ANC and Transparency mode from your Apple Watch. To do so:

  1. Tap on the AirPlay icon while the music is playing.
  2. Then choose the desired option.
    • Noise Cancellation,
    • Transparency, or
    • Off.

That concludes the talk!

Wrapping up…

Transparency is handy when you need to hear someone without removing your AirPods. If you want the sound to adjust as your surroundings change, try Adaptive Audio on a supported model.

  • How to connect AirPods Pro to Android phone

title.rendered: Flusher in Fortnite: What it is and where to find it

content.rendered:
A flusher, or port-a-potty, is an important traversal mechanic in Fortnite’s gameplay. It was first introduced in Chapter 2 Season 2 (February 2020) and has changed significantly in its usage as of the ongoing Chapter 7 Season 4.

It was initially introduced as a type of hideout, where players could take respite from the game for a few moments. And only some of them would teleport their users across a distance. However, the current iteration of port-a-potties exclusively helps the player fast-travel during a match.

The use of a flusher has been an optional thing for most players. They can use it when they happen to come across one, but not using it isn’t of any major consequence in the game. However, there can be times when accessing a flusher is integral to completing an objective, as in the case of Fortnite Override’s Geno quest, which requires you to use one.

What does a flusher do in Fortnite?

A flusher basically lets you quickly travel between two different locations in the same neighborhood during a Fortnite match. As soon as you enter it, a brief cutscene is shown, and the next thing you know is you have teleported to a different spot, though one that’s not too far away. Plus, you can even go back in, and the port-a-potty will take you to the original location once again.

This simple but highly potent traversal mechanic can be seen as an underrated aspect in Fortnite. The flusher can prove to be game-changing when you are in the Storm and low on health, by helping you considerably cut down the journey to the safe zone. Other than that, it can obviously be used to plan your escape when things go south during an enemy encounter.

In certain instances, the flusher has also been incorporated into Fortnite’s story quests. At the time of writing, there is an active Geno quest in which the player must block the former from listening to The Order’s message by travelling through a flusher.

Flusher or port-a-potty locations in Fortnite

Although spread out across different parts of the Fortnite map in modes such as Battle Royale, port-a-potties aren’t exactly abundant. There are a total of 28 port-a-potties, which ultimately form 14 pairs of fast-travel points.

It’s also worth noting that they are usually found along the coastline of the Battle Royale island, with most of them situated on the eastern half of the map. Only a few pairs of flushers can be found in the other half.

The locations of the flushers in Fortnite Battle Royale are as depicted in the image below. Also, kindly note that the Wonkeeland location has 2 pairs of flushers within the same marked circle.

Wrapping up

Traversal in fast-paced online multiplayer games is arguably as important as combat. With that said, features such as flushers, aka port-a-potties, in Fortnite are something that bring an interesting twist to conventional modes of travelling across the in-game world. Not only do they make covering more ground quick and efficient, but they also offer players a new strategic factor to experiment with in certain high-stakes scenarios during a match.

title.rendered: Alliance Tower Defense codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Alliance Tower Defense Codes on October 14, 2026

Get ready for some strategic tower defense action in Alliance Tower Defense! It’s a simple game: collect units, deploy them to fight off enemies, and upgrade your team to survive waves. However, improving your units and unlocking upgrades requires a lot of Coins, which can take time to farm. But don’t worry, as we’ve compiled a list of the latest Alliance Tower Defense codes that can be redeemed for tons of free coins!

All working Alliance Tower Defense codes

  • 20m: 400 Coins (NEW)
  • Halloween: 200 Coins (NEW)
  • SECRET: 250 Coins
  • 10M: 300 Coins

As of now, this is the only active Fishing Master code available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired or unverified Alliance Tower Defense codes

100K, 8MVISITS, BIG, FREETICKET, INSANE, MYTHIC, OPCODEFORREAL, PASS

How to redeem Alliance Tower Defense codes

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Alliance Tower Defense codes:

  1. Fire up Alliance Tower Defense on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on the Shop button.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Alliance Tower Defense codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for Alliance Tower Defense codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Alliance Tower Defense Discord server or announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Fishing Master Codes, Prehistoric Farm codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

You may like to read:

  • The Company codes

title.rendered: Prehistoric Farm codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Prehistoric Farm Codes on October 17, 2026

Prehistoric Farm brings you the fun of farming and raising your very own dinosaurs! You’ll be hunting for fossils, hatching dinosaur eggs, taking care of your prehistoric companions, and exploring different islands along the way. However, progressing through the game requires tons of resources to hatch eggs and unlock some of the best dinosaurs.

Gathering everything you need can be a bit of a grind, especially if you’re just starting out. Luckily, we’ve put together a list of the latest Prehistoric Farm codes that you can redeem for free Coins, Fragments, Double Luck, and other rewards!

All working Prehistoric Farm codes

  • NESSIEISLEAVINGSOON: 36 Nessie Shards and 10k Coins (NEW)
  • UPDATE2ITHINKSO: 20k Coins and 2x Luck for 30 min (NEW)
  • NODELAYTHISTIME: 12 Nessie Shards and 10k Coins (NEW)
  • SORRYGUYSSHUTDOWN: 48 Nessie Fragments (NEW)

As of now, these are the only active Prehistoric Farm codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired or unverified Prehistoric Farm codes

10KCCU, CWAURA, DELAYAGAIN, GOGRINDNESSIE, NESSIEISHERE, OGURICAPSORRY, SORRYFORDELAYS, SORRYFORDELAYSGUYS, UICHANGES, UPDATE05, UPDATE1, WEDIDIT

How to redeem Prehistoric Farm codes

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Prehistoric Farm codes:

  1. Fire up Prehistoric Farm on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on Settings.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.


Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Prehistoric Farm codes

Unfortunately, the developers don’t have a fixed release schedule for Prehistoric Farm codes. Most of the codes are dropped to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Prehistoric Farm Discord server for announcements.
  • Follow the game’s Roblox page for update notifications.
  • Bookmark this page, as we’ll keep it updated whenever new codes are released.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Fishing Master Codes, Alliance Tower Defense Codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

In case you missed:

  • The Company codes
  • Anime Dice codes
  • Drop a Fruit codes

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Fishing Master Codes on October 16, 2026

If you’re looking for a new Roblox game to try this season, Fishing Master is a must-check-out. What’s so unique about it? Well, not only is it a fishing game, but it’s also an action RPG. You won’t just be catching fish, as you’ll need to train your character, improve stats, and use different abilities to become the ultimate fisher.

To make your progression easier, you’ll need plenty of Auras, Skills, and other in-game resources. Luckily, we’ve found a bunch of Fishing Master codes that can help you get these rewards for free. So, let’s take a look at all the active codes you can redeem right now.

All working Fishing Master codes

  • UPD1FM: Celestial Bow Skin (NEW)
  • LOVE10KCCU: Blossom Guitar Skin
  • 2MVISITS: 5 Auras
  • 1MVISITS: 5 Skills

As of now, these are the only active Fishing Master codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired or unverified Fishing Master codes

BUMROBLOX, KVT2K4, TRUNGTHU2026

How to redeem Fishing Master codes

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Fishing Master codes:

  1. Fire up Fishing Master on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load.
  3. Click on Settings.
  4. Paste a working code and click Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the rewards, they should be added to your inventory automatically.

Where to find more Fishing Master codes
